select `providerid`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `orderid`,
    `OrderCreateDate`,
    `CurrentOrderStatus`,
    `CurrentOrderStatusReasonType`,
    `HCAM`,
    `CSM`
from 
(
    SELECT distinct p.providerid
      ,p.name ProviderName
      ,cph.orderid 
        ,o.createdon AS OrderCreateDate
        ,ost.name As CurrentOrderStatus
        ,osrt.name As CurrentOrderStatusReasonType
        ,u2.FirstName AS HCAM
        ,u.FirstName AS CSM
FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.`order` o ON o.orderid = cph.OrderID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost ON ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
LEFT JOIN  prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt ON osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = cph.ProviderID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = AccountSpecialistUserID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u2 ON u2.UserID = HCAMUserID
 where cph.date >= '2025'
) as `_`

select `OnCall`,
    `TimeDateID`,
    `DimDate`,
    `DimTimeID`,
    `MonthName`,
    `MonthYearID`,
    `DateTimeID`,
    `EndTimeID`,
    `AgentStateDetailId`,
    `Agent`,
    `AgentGroup`,
    `AgentFirstName`,
    `AgentLastName`,
    `Time`,
    `State`,
    `Duration`,
    `ReasonCode`,
    `AgentStateTime`,
    `hours`,
    `minute`,
    `StartTimeID`,
    `DateID`,
    `Date`,
    `name_join`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS(
      WITH CTE AS (
SELECT AgentStateDetailId
      ,Agent
      ,AgentGroup
      ,AgentFirstName
      ,AgentLastName
      ,Time
      ,State
      ,second(agentstatetime) + (minute(agentstatetime)*60) Duration
      ,ReasonCode
      ,AgentStateTime
      ,date_format(Time, 'HH') hours
      ,date_format(Time, 'mm') minute
      ,(hours*100)+minute StartTimeID
      ,Date_format(To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd'),"yyyyMMdd") DateID
      ,To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') Date
       ,CASE WHEN Agent = 'leebasara.exito@aplaceformom.com' THEN 'sarae' 
             WHEN Agent = 'gregory.alsola@aplaceformom.com' THEN 'grega'
             ELSE LOWER(CONCAT(LEFT(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)-1),SUBSTRING(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)+1,1))) 
        END AS name_join
 FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_import.five9dailyagentstatedetails
  WHERE  (month(To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd')) >= month(add_months(date_trunc("MM",getdate()), -1)))
  and year(To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd')) = year(getdate())
  and agentstatetime <> '24:00:00' 
  and agentgroup = 'AC HCAM' 
  and state = 'On Call'
  ORDER BY AgentStateDetailId DESC
),

CTEA AS(
      select dateid TimeDateID
       ,date DimDate
       ,month
       ,year
       ,timeid DimTimeID
       ,time
       ,monthyearid
       ,monthname
       ,concat(dateid,timeid) DateTimeID 
FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
cross join prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtime
where date >= '2025-06-01'
order by date, timeid
)

Select CTEA.TimeDateID 
      ,CTEA.DimDate
      ,CTEA.DimTimeID
      ,CTEA.MonthName
      ,CTEA.MonthYearID
      ,CTEA.DateTimeID
      ,date_format(timestampadd(SECOND, duration,cte.time ),"Hmm") EndTimeID
       ,CTE.*

from cte
LEFT JOIN CTEA on CTEA.TimeDateID = CTE.DateID
)

Select CASE WHEN (DimTimeID >= StartTimeID and DimTimeID <= EndTimeID) THEN 1 
           ELSE 0 
           END as OnCall
      ,CTE1.*
FROM CTE1
ORDER BY DimDate, DimTimeID, Agent
)

SELECT *
FROM CTE2
where oncall = 1
) as `_`

select * 
from 
(
    SELECT ReferralNoteID
      ,ReferralProcessStageID
	  ,rn.CreatedOn
      ,rn.ReferralID
	  ,r.ProviderID
,p.name ProviderName
	  ,CASE WHEN ref.referredon <= '2025-06-23' then LEFT(rn.Notes,CHARINDEX(' -',rn.Notes)) else rsrt.name end ReturnReason 
	  ,RIGHT(rn.Notes,LEN(rn.Notes) - CHARINDEX('- ',rn.Notes)) AS ReturnNote
      ,u.FirstName
      ,po.name OrgName
,r.digitaljourney 
 FROM main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referralnote rn on ref.referralid = rn.referralid 
  LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referralreturnrequest rr on rr.referralid = ref.referralid 
  LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referralreturnprimaryreasontype rprt on rprt.referralreturnprimaryreasontypeid = rr.PrimaryReasonTypeID
  LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referralreturnsecondaryreasontype rsrt on rsrt.referralreturnsecondaryreasontypeid = rr.SecondaryReasonTypeID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = rn.CreatedBy
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ReferralID,digitaljourney,
					ProviderID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral
				  WHERE referralstatustypeid = 5 AND BillingTypeID = 3 AND ReferredOn >= '2023-01-01') r ON r.ReferralID = rn.ReferralID
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on ref.providerid = p.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerorganization po on po.providerorganizationid = p.providerorganizationid
  WHERE rn.ReferralProcessStageID = 11
  AND r.ReferralID IS NOT NULL
) as `_`
limit 0

select * 
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT req.HMCRequestID
	 ,ReferralID
      --,ReferralStatusTypeID
      --,Returnapproved
      ,case when returnapproved = true then 1 else 0 end return
      ,CAST(ModifiedOn as date) ModifiedOn 
	  ,cast(req.createdate as date) createdate
	  ,ref.CreatedOn
     -- ,ref.HMCLeadID
  --    ,OrderID
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
  left Join prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.HMCLeadID = ref.HMCLeadID
 left Join prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest req on l.HMCRequestID = req.HMCRequestID
  Where (BillingTypeID = 3
	and ref.HMCLeadID is not null)
        and ref.createdon > '2025-01-01'
) as `_`
limit 0

select `CityID`,
    `City`,
    `City_State`,
    `StateProvinceID`,
    `ModifiedOn`,
    `ModifiedBy`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    `CreatedBy`
from 
(
    SELECT CityID
      ,c.Name AS City
	  ,CONCAT(c.Name,', ',st.Iso2Code) AS City_State
      ,c.StateProvinceID
      ,c.ModifiedOn
      ,c.ModifiedBy
      ,c.CreatedOn
      ,c.CreatedBy
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_geo.city c
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_geo.stateprovince st ON c.StateProvinceID = st.StateProvinceID
) as `_`

 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode dpc on dpc.postalcodeid = p.postalcodeid 
 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.AccountID, u2.FirstName AS HCAM
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op ON op.ProviderID = p.ProviderID
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.OrderID = op.OrderID
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.account a ON a.AccountID = o.AccountID
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = AccountSpecialistUserID
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u2 ON u2.UserID = HCAMUserID
				    WHERE a.AccountID IS NOT NULL AND u2.FirstName IS NOT NULL ) hcamacc ON hcamacc.AccountID = o.AccountID
    WHERE o.ServiceTypeID = 2 AND o.BillingTypeID = 3 and
      Date >= '2022-01-01' and (cph.orderstatus = 'Active' OR cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' OR cph.orderstatus = 'Paused') AND ContractType = 'CPL'
GROUP BY cph.ProviderID,cph.ProviderName,cph.OrderID,o.createdon,ost.name,osrt.name,u2.FirstName,u.FirstName, PostalCode ,p.postalcodeid ,p.providerid, code
)

WITH CTE3 AS

,apfm.lt_form_submit_channel

 WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE 'Affiliates'

,hmcr.affiliateID
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute TimeID

,aff.affiliatename
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ

      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'

      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'

	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =6 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as LSTF
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =2 then 1 else 0 END as RL
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate aff on aff.affiliateid = hmcr.affiliateid

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,

                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2022-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL) AND (hmcr.affiliateid <> 140 OR hmcr.postalcode <> 99732))

from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
  WITH CTE1 AS( 
  WITH CTE AS( 
  Select o.id OpportunityID 
      ,o.close_date
      ,a.hmc_cart_provider_id_c ProviderID

 JOIN main.community_salesforce.account a on a.id = o.account_id 
 WHERE --o.is_won = true

  --and a.hmc_cart_provider_id_c = 49349
)

      Select CTE.ProviderID 
      ,p.name ProviderName 
      ,cph.OrderID 
      ,CTE.close_date
      ,min(date) FirstActiveDate
      ,max(date) LastActiveDate

 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cph.providerid =cte.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cte.providerid

   and cph.contracttype = 'CPL'
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   --and p.providerorganizationid is null 
   and cph.date >= '2025-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4    
)

       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.OrderID is null then op.orderid else CTEC.OrderID end OrderID  
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.ProviderName is null then p.name else CTEC.ProviderName end ProviderName 
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.Close_Date is null then CTE.Close_Date else CTEC.Close_Date end close_date
       ,CTEC.firstactivedate
       ,CTEC.lastactivedate
      FROM CTE     
     LEFT JOIN CTEC on CTEC.ProviderID = CTE.ProviderID

select `ReferralID`,

    `ActivatedOnDate`,
    `Activations`,

    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    `ReturnApproved`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,

from

      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral

	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0

      ,CTE.OrderStatusReason CurrentOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.OrderCreateDate
      ,CTE.HCAM

      ,hcc.createdon ChargeCreateDate
      ,cph.orderstatus CPHOrderStatus
      ,cph.orderstatusreason CPHOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.prepaidautorenew
      ,cte.prepaidtotal
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hcc.homecarechargeid ORDER BY cph.cartproviderhistoryid desc) as RN
      ,LagDate
      ,his.orderstatus LastOrderStatus
      ,his.orderstatusreason LastOrderStatusReason
      ,DateSuspended

 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.OrderID = CTE.OrderID

 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cast(cph.date as date) = cast(add_months(hcc.createdon, 1) as date) and cph.accountid = hcc.accountid and CTE.orderid = cph.orderid

  LEFT JOIN (Select cph.*, date DateSuspended

select `ReferralID`,
    `LeadID`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `ActDate`,
    `NumProv`,
    cast(`ReferredOn` as DATE) as `C1`,
    `HT`,
    `Activation`,
    `AnyHT`,
    `AnyActivation`,
    `BusinessUnit`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS (
SELECT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
,r.ProviderID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,ActivatedOn
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.OrderID = 2774 then 34
			WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
,CASE WHEN (r.HMCLeadID IS NULL AND BillingTypeID = 1) THEN 1 
	  WHEN dca.Source = 'APFM Screened Leads' THEN 1 
	  ELSE 0 END AS APFM
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimhomecarerequest dhcr on hmcr.HMCRequestID = dhcr.RequestID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimcustomeracquisition dca on dca.CustomerAcquisitionKey = dhcr.CustomerAcquisitionKey
  WHERE r.ReferredOn > '2023-01-01' AND BillingTypeID = 1
)

SELECT t.ReferralID,t.LeadID,t.ProviderID,ActDate,NumProv,t.ReferredOn,t.HT,CASE WHEN ActivatedOn IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Activation,grp.HT AS AnyHT,grp.Activation AS AnyActivation, 'APFM' as BusinessUnit
FROM CTE t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT LeadID,SUM(HT) AS HT,COUNT(ActivatedOn) AS Activation, MIN(ActivatedOn) AS ActDate, COUNT(ReferralID) AS NumProv
			FROM CTE 
			GROUP BY LeadID) grp ON grp.LeadID = t.LeadID
WHERE APFM = 1
ORDER BY t.LeadID desc
) as `_`

        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0

			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42

select `ProviderID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `FirstActive`,
    `LastActive`,
    `OrderStatus`,
    `OrderReason`,
    `resumedate`,
    `monthlycap`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS( 
  Select cph.providerid 
        ,cph.orderid 
        ,min(cph.date) FirstActive 
        ,max(cph.date) LastActive
  FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
   JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
     WHERE p.providerorganizationid = 123
       and (cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' or cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused'))
     GROUP BY 1,2 
)
,CTEA AS(
  Select cte.providerid 
        ,fromdate 
        ,resumedate 
  FROM CTE
   JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.pausereferralrequest p on p.providerid = cte.providerid
    where approved= true 
    and date(getdate()) >= fromdate and date(getdate()) <= resumedate
    )

Select DISTINCT CTE.ProviderID 
      ,CTE.OrderID 
      ,CTE.FirstActive 
      ,CTE.LastActive 
      ,case when ctea.providerid is not null and ost.name not in ('Completed', 'Cancelled', 'Suspended') then 'Paused' else ost.name end OrderStatus 
      ,case when ctea.providerid is not null and ost.name not in ('Completed', 'Cancelled', 'Suspended') then 'Provider Pause' else osrt.name end OrderReason 
      ,CTEa.resumedate 
      ,op.monthlycap
FROM CTE 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cte.orderid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.orderid = cte.orderid and op.providerid = cte.providerid
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost on ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt on osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
 LEFT JOIN CTEA on CTEA.providerid = cte.providerid
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `ReferralID`,
    `LeadID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `HMCRequestID`,
    `YGL_Lead_ID`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `Activations`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    cast(`ReturnApproved` as BIGINT) as `C1`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `Org`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `ReferralRevenue`
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
         ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `hmcprospectid`,
    `postalcode`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `requeststatuscode`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `AttemptCount`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `Note`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `hmcscreenqueueid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `hours`,
    `minute`,
    `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
    `rn`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `C1`,
    `C2`,
    `C2` - `C1` as `C3`
from 
(
    select `hmcrequestid`,
        `hmcprospectid`,
        `postalcode`,
        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `requeststatuscode`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `Adjust_CreateDate`,
        `AttemptCount`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `Note`,
        `affiliateID`,
        `hmcscreenqueueid`,
        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `djstepid`,
        `DJType`,
        `hours`,
        `minute`,
        `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
        `rn`,
        `RequestHalfHour`,
        `RequestHour`,
        `DuringOperatingHours`,
        (cast(year(`createdate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(10000 as DOUBLE) + cast(month(`createdate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(100 as DOUBLE)) + cast(dayofmonth(`createdate`) as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast(year(`ScreeningDate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(10000 as DOUBLE) + cast(month(`ScreeningDate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(100 as DOUBLE)) + cast(dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 

    ,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= dateadd(month, -7,getdate()) AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

SElect *,
    date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',createdate)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour,
    HOUR(createdate) AS RequestHour,
    CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
    ELSE 0 END as DuringOperatingHours
FROM CTE 
Where rn =1
order by hmcrequestid desc
    ) as `_`
) as `ITBL`

select *
from (
with cte1 as( 
  WITH CTE AS( 
      SELECT
    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)
     Select date(hmcr.createdate) RequestCreatedate 
      ,hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid = 100 then 'DJ Completed' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'SLA' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            else "Care Advisor"
       END Referredby
       ,hmcr.affiliateid 
       ,hmcr.leadsource
       ,ref.referralid 
       ,case when ref.returnapproved is true then 'Returned' 
             when ref.returnapproved is false then 'Attempted'
             else 'Not Attempted' 
             end ReturnStatus
       ,concat(ref.providerid, '-', ref.orderid) ProviderOrders
       ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate 
       ,case when day(hmcr.createdate) <= 7 then "First 7" 
            when date_diff(day, hmcr.createdate, last_day(hmcr.createdate)) < 6 then 'Last 7'
            else "Middle"
            end TimeFrame
      ,datediff(activatedon, requestcreatedate) DaystoActivation
       ,case when ref.activatedon is not null then 'Activated' else 'Not Activated' end Activation 
       ,date(ref.activatedon) ActivationDate 
       ,htr.referralid htrreferral
       ,CASE WHEN cte.zip5 is not null then 'South Texas' else 'Other' end PilotGroup
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid and htr.hottransferresponseid = 1
 LEFT JOIN CTE on cte.zip5 = hmcr.postalcode
 WHERE hmcr.createdate >= '2026'
)

   WITH CTE AS(

                     ELSE LOWER(CONCAT(LEFT(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)-1),SUBSTRING(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)+1,1))) 
                     END AS name_join

    `ManualTime`,
    `DialTime`,

    `HoldTime`,
    `RingTime`,
    `Call_Direction`,

    `name_join`

(

SELECT CallId,SUM(CASE WHEN CallType = '3rd party conference' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Transfers_Attempted

GROUP BY CallId
ORDER BY CallId),

CTE1 AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
      f9.CallId
      ,Timestamp
   ,date_format(Timestamp, 'HH') hours
,date_format(Timestamp, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute
      ,Agent
      ,AgentName
      ,CallType
      ,Disposition
      ,DispositionPath
      ,CallTime
      ,TalkTime
      ,DNIS
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY agent, date(timestamp), dnis ORDER BY timestamp) UniqueCall 
      ,HandleTime
      ,ConsultTime
      ,TotalQueueTime
      ,ManualTime
      ,DialTime
      ,AgentGroup
      ,AfterCallWorkTime
      ,HoldTime
      ,RingTime
	  ,CASE WHEN CallType IN ('Inbound','Inbound Voicemail') THEN 'Inbound'

      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42

			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34

    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)

  Select DISTINCT CASE WHEN zip5 is null then 'Other' else 'South Texas' end DMA 
      ,dma.zip
FROM main.reporting.dim_geography_zip_dma dma
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.zip5 = dma.zip
)

,CTEA AS (
    Select DISTINCT cph.date
     ,date_format(cph.date, 'yyyyMM') monthyearid 
      ,concat(cph.providerid, "-",cph.orderid) ProviderOrderID 
      ,CASE WHEN cph.orderstatus = 'Active' and cph.date= last_day(cph.date) then concat(cph.providerid, "-",cph.orderid) else null end ActiveEOM
      ,psc.postalcode
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on psc.providerid = cph.providerid
  WHERE (cph.date = last_day(cph.date) or cph.date = date(getdate()))
  and cph.date >= '2026'
   and (cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' or cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused'))
   and cph.contracttype = 'CPL'
   and psc.deleted = 0 
)

,CTEB AS( 
  Select Date
        ,DMA
        ,monthyearid
        ,postalcode 
        ,count(distinct ProviderOrderID) ActivePlus 
        ,count(distinct ActiveEOM) ActiveEOM 
  FROM CTEA
  left join cte on cte.zip = ctea.postalcode
   GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)

Select CTE.DMA 
      ,monthyearid
      --,CTE.Zip 
      ,median(ActivePlus) ActivePlus 
      ,median(ActiveEOM) ActiveEOM 
FROM CTE  
 LEFT JOIN CTEB on CTE.zip = CTEB.postalcode 
  GROUP BY 1,2
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `ProviderOrderID`,
    `Referrals`,
    `Activations`,
    `Rev`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS( 
  Select ref.referralid 
      ,case when ref.activatedon is null then null else ref.referralid end Activation 
      ,ref.providerID 
      ,ref.orderid 
      ,concat(ref.providerid, "-", ref.orderid) ProviderOrderID 
      , CASE WHEN ref.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
FROM main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = ref.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
 WHERE hmcleadid is not null 
    and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
    and (ref.returnapproved = false or ref.returnapproved is null )
)

Select ProviderOrderID 
      ,count(distinct referralid) Referrals 
      ,count(distinct Activation) Activations 
      ,sum(referralrevenue) Rev
  FROM CTE 
  GROUP BY 1
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `Date`,
    `DMA`,
    cast({ fn round(cast(`MonthYear` as DOUBLE), 0) } as BIGINT) as `C1`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE3 AS ( 
      WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on  year(cte.date) = year(cph.date) and if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
      ,dma.DMA
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on psc.providerid = p.providerid
LEFT JOIN main.reporting.dim_geography_zip_dma dma on dma.zip = psc.postalcode
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
   and cph.orderid <> 2774
   and psc.deleted = 0 
   and DMA <> 'NA'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

       Select distinct cph.orderid 
               ,count(distinct psc.postalcode) OrderZips 
               ,DMA.DMA
               ,DMA2.TotalOrderZips
               ,cph.date
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on psc.providerid = cph.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN main.reporting.dim_geography_zip_dma dma on dma.zip = psc.postalcode

select `hmcrequestid`,

    `ScreeningDate`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `AttemptCount`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `Note`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `hmcscreenqueueid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `hours`,
    `minute`,
    `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
    `rn`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `C1`,
    `C2`,
    `C2` - `C1` as `C3`
from 
(
    select `hmcrequestid`,
        `hmcprospectid`,
        `postalcode`,
        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `requeststatuscode`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `Adjust_CreateDate`,
        `AttemptCount`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `Note`,
        `affiliateID`,

        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `djstepid`,
        `DJType`,
        `hours`,
        `minute`,
        `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
        `rn`,
        `RequestHalfHour`,
        `RequestHour`,
        `DuringOperatingHours`,
        (cast({ fn year(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
    ,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID

				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

SElect *,
    date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',createdate)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour,
    HOUR(createdate) AS RequestHour,
    CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
 FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier

   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
   LEFT JOIN CTE1 on CTE1.hmcprospectid2 = hmcr.hmcprospectid 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign
                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2024-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL)
)

      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph

      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap

 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap

        else "Franchise"
        END Org

select `Date`,
    `DMA`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
      ,dma.DMA
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on psc.providerid = p.providerid
LEFT JOIN main.reporting.dim_geography_zip_dma dma on dma.zip = psc.postalcode
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
   and psc.deleted = 0 
   and DMA <> 'NA'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

Select Date 
      ,DMA
      ,date_format(date, 'yyyyMM') MonthYear
      ,Org
      ,sum(cap) Adjust_MonthlyCap
      ,Count(distinct orderid) Orders
FROM CTE2
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
) as `_`
limit 1000

select * 
from 
(
    SELECT DateID
      ,Date
      ,DayOfYear
      ,DayOfMonth
      ,DayOfWeek
      ,WeekDayName
      ,Month
      ,MonthName
      ,Year
      ,weekofyear(date) WeekofYear
      ,MonthYearID
  FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
 where date <= dateadd(Year,1,date_trunc('year',getdate()))
   and date >=  dateadd(Year,-1,date_trunc('year',getdate()))
   order by date asc
) as `_`
limit 0

select * 
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS
(
SELECT DateID
      ,Date
	  ,CASE WHEN DayOfWeek = 2 THEN Date 
	  WHEN DayOfWeek > 2 THEN DATEADD(day, 2- DayOfWeek,Date)
	  ELSE DATEADD(day, -6,Date)
	  END as WeekStart
      ,DayOfYear
      ,DayOfMonth
      ,DayOfWeek
      ,WeekDayName
      ,Month
      ,MonthName
      ,Year
	  ,Year(Getdate()) as ModYear
	  ,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year(Getdate())) as ModMonthYear
,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year) AS MonthYear
      ,MonthYearID
  FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
  WHERE  DateID Between Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric) and Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric)
  )

  SELECT CTE.DateID
      ,CTE.Date
	  ,CASE WHEN CTE.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) THEN DATEADD(YEAR, 1, CTE.Date) 
	  ELSE CTE.Date
	  END as ModDate
	  ,CTE.WeekStart
	  ,COALESCE(cte2.WeekStart, CTE.WeekStart) as ModWeekStart
      ,CTE.DayOfYear
      ,CTE.DayOfMonth
      ,CTE.DayOfWeek
      ,CTE.WeekDayName
      ,CTE.Month
      ,CTE.MonthName
      ,CTE.Year
	  ,CTE.ModYear
	  ,CTE.ModMonthYear
,CTE.MonthYear
      ,CTE.MonthYearID
  FROM CTE 
  LEFT JOIN CTE cte2 on CTE.DayOfYear = cte2.DayOfYear AND cte2.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) AND CTE.Year = Year(Getdate())
) as `_`
limit 0

select `ReferralID`,
    `LeadID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `HMCRequestID`,
    `YGL_Lead_ID`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `activatedon`,
    `ActivatedOnDate`,
    `Activations`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    cast(`ReturnApproved` as BIGINT) as `C2`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `Providername`,
    `ReferralRevenue`,
    `ReturnApproved` as `C1`
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,r.activatedon
      ,DATE(r.activatedon) AS ActivatedOnDate
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
    ,p.name Providername
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `Date`,
    cast({ fn round(cast(`MonthYear` as DOUBLE), 0) } as BIGINT) as `C1`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

      ,sum(cap) Adjust_MonthlyCap
      ,Count(distinct orderid) Orders

from 
(

        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `AdjChannel`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `DJType`,
        `SourceP`,
        (cast({ fn year(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
     -- WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on a.affiliateID = hmcr.affiliateid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate

				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'

WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

       SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY createdate desc) srn 
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr

	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =2 then 1 else 0 END as RL
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate aff on aff.affiliateid = hmcr.affiliateid

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,

                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign

                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip'

      ,r.CreatedOn

      ,OrderID
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral

	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-12-01'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-12-01'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount

			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34

select `RequestCreatedate`,
    `hmcrequestid`,
    `Referredby`,
    `affiliateid`,
    `leadsource`,
    `referralid`,
    `requeststatusid`,
    `ReturnStatus`,
    `ProviderOrders`,
    `ReferralDate`,
    `TimeFrame`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `DaystoActivation`,
    `Activation`,
    `ActivationDate`,
    `PilotGroup`,
    `referredbysource`,
    `RequestCreatedate` as `C1`,
    `ActivationDate` as `C2`
from 
(
    with cte1 as( 
  WITH CTE AS( 
      SELECT
    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)

 Select date(hmcr.createdate) RequestCreatedate 
      ,hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid = 100 then 'DJ Completed' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'SLA' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            else "Care Advisor"
       END Referredby
       ,hmcr.affiliateid 
       ,hmcr.leadsource
       ,ref.referralid 
       ,hmcr.requeststatusid
       ,case when ref.returnapproved is true then 'Returned' 
             when ref.returnapproved is false then 'Attempted'
             else 'Not Attempted' 
             end ReturnStatus
       ,concat(ref.providerid, '-', ref.orderid) ProviderOrders
       ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate 
       ,case when day(hmcr.createdate) <= 7 then "First 7" 
            when date_diff(day, hmcr.createdate, last_day(hmcr.createdate)) < 6 then 'Last 7'
            else "Middle"
            end TimeFrame
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      --      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 107 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,113,133--,107 
            ) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            --WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as AdjChannel
      ,datediff(activatedon, requestcreatedate) DaystoActivation
       ,case when ref.activatedon is not null then 'Activated' else 'Not Activated' end Activation 
       ,date(ref.activatedon) ActivationDate 
       ,htr.referralid htrreferral
       ,CASE WHEN cte.zip5 is not null then 'South Texas' else 'Other' end PilotGroup
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid and htr.hottransferresponseid = 1
 LEFT JOIN CTE on cte.zip5 = hmcr.postalcode
 WHERE hmcr.createdate >= '2026'
)

           when Referredby = 'SLA' and lower(leadsource) = 'api' then 'HCOnly'

(
    WITH CTE2 AS (

WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate

      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'

  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `DJType`,
    `SourceP`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on a.affiliateID = hmcr.affiliateid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)
