select `Date`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on year(cte.date) = year(cph.date) and if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

Select Date 
      ,date_format(date, 'yyyyMM') MonthYear
      ,Org
      ,sum(cap) Adjust_MonthlyCap
      ,Count(distinct orderid) Orders
FROM CTE2
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
) as `_`
limit 1000

        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0

			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34

      ,CTE.OrderCreateDate

 LEFT JOIN (Select distinct cph.*
                  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.Date desc) rn

          LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid

  LEFT JOIN (Select cph.*, date DateSuspended

              LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid

select `DateID`,
    `DayofWeek`,
    `DayofMonth`,
    `MonthYearID`,
    `Date`,
    `Month`,
    `Year`,
    `DayofYear`,
    `MonthName`,
    `WeekofYear`
from 
(
    Select DateID 
      ,DayofWeek
      ,DayofMonth
      ,MonthYearID
      ,Date
      ,Month
      ,Year
      ,DayofYear
      ,MonthName
      ,weekofyear(date) WeekofYear
FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
where date > '2024' and date < date_add(Year, 1,date_trunc('year',getdate()))
) as `_`

select `ProviderID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `ProviderOrders`,
    `FirstActive`,
    `LastActive`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `OrgName`,
    `Org`,
    `OrderStatus`,
    `OrderStatusReason`,
    `ProviderCoverage`,
    `DaysActive`,
    `Status`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS( 
     Select cph.providerid 
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,max(cph.date) LastActive 
      ,min(cph.date) FirstActive 
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
 WHERE (cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' or cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused'))
   and cph.contracttype = 'CPL'
 GROUP BY 1,2 
)

,CTEA AS (
     Select DISTINCT cph.providerid 
           ,cph.orderid 
           ,cph.orderstatus 
           ,cph.orderstatusreason 
    FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
    where date = date(getdate())
)

,CTEB1 AS ( 
       SELECT
    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)

,CTEB AS ( 
     Select psc.providerid 
           ,count(distinct psc.postalcode) ProviderPostalCode 
           ,count(distinct cteb1.zip5) Zip5Cov
           ,Zip5Cov/providerpostalcode ProviderCoverage 
    FROM main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc 
    LEFT JOIN CTEB1 on psc.postalcode = cteb1.zip5
    WHERE psc.deleted = 0 
     GROUP BY 1
)

Select CTE.ProviderID 
      ,CTE.OrderID 
      ,concat(CTE.ProviderID,'-',CTE.OrderID) ProviderOrders
      ,CTE.FirstActive 
      ,CTE.LastActive
      ,p.name ProviderName 
      ,case when p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent" else po.name end OrgName
      ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent" else "Franchise"  END Org
      ,CASE WHEN CTEA.orderstatus is null then ost.name else ctea.orderstatus end OrderStatus 
      ,case when ctea.orderstatusreason is null then osrt.name else ctea.orderstatusreason end OrderStatusReason 
      ,ProviderCoverage
      ,datediff(lastactive,firstactive) DaysActive
        ,CASE WHEN (ctea.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' or ctea.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused')) then 'Active+'  
            WHEN ctea.orderstatus = 'Onboarding' then 'Onboarding' 
            when ost.name = 'Completed' then 'Completed'
            else 'Inactive' 
            end Status
FROM CTE 
LEFT JOIN CTEA on CTEA.providerid = cte.providerid  and ctea.orderid = cte.orderid
JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on CTE.providerid = p.providerid
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cte.orderid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost on ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt on osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerorganization po on po.providerorganizationid = p.providerorganizationid
LEFT JOIN CTEB on CTEB.providerid = CTE.providerid
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `DMA`,
    `MonthYearID`,
    `postalcode`,
    `TotalRls`,
    `Last3DayRls`,
    `First3DayRls`
from 
(
    WITH CTE1 AS ( 
      WITH CTE AS (
      Select DISTINCT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,date(hmcr.createdate) CreateDate 
      ,dateadd(Day, 2, date_trunc("Month", hmcr.createdate)) First3Days
      ,dateadd(Day, -2, last_day(hmcr.createdate)) Last3Days
      ,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'yyyyMM') MonthYearID 
      ,dma.dma
      ,trim(hmcr.postalcode) postalcode
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on  hmcr.hmcrequestid = hmcl.hmcleadid

)

Select DMA 
      ,MonthYearID 
      ,CASE WHEN createdate >= Last3Days and CreateDate <= last_day(createdate) then hmcrequestid else null end Last3DayRls
      ,CASE WHEN createdate <= First3Days and CreateDate >= date_trunc("Month",createdate) then hmcrequestid else null end First3DayRls
      ,createdate
      ,hmcrequestid
      ,postalcode
FROM CTE
)

Select DMA
      ,MonthYearID 
      ,postalcode
      ,count(distinct hmcrequestid) TotalRls 
      ,count(distinct Last3DayRls) Last3DayRls
      ,count(distinct First3DayRls) First3DayRls

GROUP BY 1,2,3
) as `_`

    `Channel`,
    `DJType`
from 
(
    select distinct l.hmcleadid 
       ,r.firstname
       ,r.lastname
       ,hmcr.postalcode
       ,r.emailaddress
       ,rp.phonenumber
    ,CASE  WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132) THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,136,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END Channel
     ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN "SEM After Hours" 
	       WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
           WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email' 
           WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In Hours'
           WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5	THEN 'SEO After Hours' 
           WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6	THEN 'SEO In Hours' 
           END DJType

from prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l 
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcr.hmcrequestid = l.hmcrequestid
JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect r on r.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid

(

      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'

,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign

                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *

                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute

  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)

				  ,CreateDate

				  ,NoteID

			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'

			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap

 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)

)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
      ,dma.DMA
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on psc.providerid = p.providerid
LEFT JOIN main.reporting.dim_geography_zip_dma dma on dma.zip = psc.postalcode

select `RequestCreatedate`,
    `hmcrequestid`,
    `Referredby`,
    `referralid`,
    `ReturnStatus`,
    `ProviderOrders`,
    `ReferralDate`,
    `TimeFrame`,
    `Activation`,
    `ActivationDate`,
    `PilotGroup`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS( 
      SELECT
    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)
     Select date(hmcr.createdate) RequestCreatedate 
      ,hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid = 100 then 'DJ Completed' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'SLA' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            WHEN htr.referralid is not null then 'CA HT' 
            else 'CA Not HT'
       END Referredby
       ,ref.referralid 
       ,case when ref.returnapproved is true then 'Returned' 
             when ref.returnapproved is false then 'Attempted'
             else 'Not Attempted' 
             end ReturnStatus
       ,concat(ref.providerid, '-', ref.orderid) ProviderOrders
       ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate 
       ,case when day(hmcr.createdate) <= 7 then "First 7" 
            when date_diff(day, hmcr.createdate, last_day(hmcr.createdate)) < 6 then 'Last 7'
            else "Middle"
            end TimeFrame
       ,case when ref.activatedon is not null then 'Activated' else 'Not Activated' end Activation 
       ,date(ref.activatedon) ActivationDate 
       ,CASE WHEN cte.zip5 is not null then 'South Texas' else 'Other' end PilotGroup
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid and htr.hottransferresponseid = 1
 LEFT JOIN CTE on cte.zip5 = hmcr.postalcode
 WHERE hmcr.createdate >= '2026'
) as `_`

from

,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn'

      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)

      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral

	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34

          ,concat(ref.orderid,"-",ref.providerid ) ProviderOrder
          ,ref.orderid 
          ,op.createdon
          ,datediff(getdate(),o.createdon) OrderAge
          ,datediff(ref.referredon,o.createdon) ReferralAge
          ,p.name ProviderName
          ,case when p.providerorganizationid is null then 'Independent'
                else 'Franchise'
                END Org 
          ,case when ref.returnapproved = true then 1 else 0 end ReturnApproved
         ,CASE WHEN ref.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
    FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
    LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ref.providerid 
    LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order op on op.orderid = ref.orderid 
    LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = ref.orderid
    LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = ref.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
    where ref.referredon >= '2023'
    and op.createdon >= '2023'
     and ref.billingtypeid = 3
    and ref.hmcleadid is not null
    and o.orderstatustypeid <> 0 
     and (lower(p.name) not like '%home instead%' and lower(p.name) not like 'senior helpers%')
     and datediff(getdate(),o.createdon) >= 180
     and datediff(ref.referredon,o.createdon) <=180
)

select `HMCRequestID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `Flow`,

    `Channel`,
    `IsDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `Source`,
    `formname`,
    `TimeID`,
    `SiteSection`,
    `SEMForm`,
    `EmailType`,
    `RequestDateTime`,
    `RequestStatusID`,
    `Lead`,
    `LSTF`,
    `RL`,
    `CampaignID`,
    `CampaignName`
from 
(
    WITH CTE3 AS
(WITH CTE2 AS 
(WITH CTE AS 
(SELECT distinct hmcr.HMCRequestID
,hmcr.HMCProspectID
,hmcr.postalcode
,hmcr.affiliateid
,hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
,apfm.lt_form_submit_channel
,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow =1 then 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Flow
,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
 WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
 WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE 'Affiliates'
END as AdjChannel
,hmcr.affiliateID
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute TimeID
,hmcr.url
,aff.affiliatename
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
,sr.outcomeid
,formname
      ,CAST(hmcr.createdate as date) AS RequestDateTime
	  ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
	  ,1 as Lead
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =6 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as LSTF
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =2 then 1 else 0 END as RL
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate aff on aff.affiliateid = hmcr.affiliateid

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign

                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2022-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL) AND (hmcr.affiliateid <> 140 OR hmcr.postalcode <> 99732))

WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'

select `RequestCreatedate`,
    `hmcrequestid`,
    `Referredby`,
    `referralid`,
    `ReturnStatus`,
    `ProviderOrders`,
    `ReferralDate`,
    `TimeFrame`,
    `Activation`,
    `ActivationDate`,
    `PilotGroup`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS( 
      SELECT
    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)
     Select date(hmcr.createdate) RequestCreatedate 
      ,hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid = 100 then 'DJ Completed' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'SLA' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            WHEN htr.referralid is not null then 'CA HT' 
            else 'CA Not HT'
       END Referredby
       ,ref.referralid 
       ,case when ref.returnapproved is true then 'Returned' 
             when ref.returnapproved is false then 'Attempted'
             else 'Not Attempted' 
             end ReturnStatus
       ,concat(ref.providerid, '-', ref.orderid) ProviderOrders
       ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate 
       ,case when day(hmcr.createdate) <= 7 then "First 7" 
            when date_diff(day, hmcr.createdate, last_day(hmcr.createdate)) < 6 then 'Last 7'
            else "Middle"
            end TimeFrame
       ,case when ref.activatedon is not null then 'Activated' else 'Not Activated' end Activation 
       ,date(ref.activatedon) ActivationDate 
       ,CASE WHEN cte.zip5 is not null then 'South Texas' else 'Other' end PilotGroup
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid and htr.hottransferresponseid = 1
 LEFT JOIN CTE on cte.zip5 = hmcr.postalcode
 WHERE hmcr.createdate >= '2026'
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `Date`,

from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774

      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on cte.monthyear = date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy')
 and day(cph.date) = 15
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
      ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and  cph.monthlycap < (2*cph.monthlysent) then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and (cph.monthlycap >= (2*cph.monthlysent) or cph.monthlysent is null) then 200
       else cph.monthlycap 
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE day(cph.date) = 15
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

      ,Count(distinct orderid) Orders

  GROUP BY 1,2

limit 1000

    `DJStep`,
    `DJType`,
    `SourceP`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
     -- WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate

          ,p.name ProviderName
          ,case when p.providerorganizationid is null then 'Independent'
                else 'Franchise'
                END Org 
          ,case when ref.returnapproved = true then 1 else 0 end ReturnApproved
         ,CASE WHEN ref.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0

      ,monthlysent

      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))

 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid

 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap

            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 2 then "Within 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 3 then "Greater than 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 4 then "Unsure"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 5 then "Within 7 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 6 then "No rush"
            else null
            END WhenCareNeeded
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid in (1,2,5) then 1
            ELSE 0
            END LessThan30Days
     ,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
     ,ref.ReferralID 
     ,ref.ReferredOn
     ,ref.billingtypeid
     ,ref.providerid
     ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
     ,p.Name ProviderName
     ,po.name Org
     ,ref.activatedon
     ,CASE WHEN ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,1,ref.ReferredOn) then 1
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,1,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn)) then 2
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn)) then 3
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,4,ReferredOn)) then 4
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,4,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,5,ReferredOn)) then 5
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,5,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,6,ReferredOn)) then 6
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,6,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,7,ReferredOn)) then 7
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,7,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,8,ReferredOn)) then 8
           WHEN ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,8,ReferredOn) then 9
           else Null
           End ToActivation
     ,ref.returnapproved
     ,year(hmcr.createdate) Year
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequestphonenumber hmcrp on hmcrp.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ref.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerorganization po on po.providerorganizationid = p.providerorganizationid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = ref.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  Where hmcr.createdate >= '2023' and  hmcr.createdate < date_add(year, 1, date_trunc('Year', getdate()))

SELECT hmcr.HMCRequestID

      ,hmcpd.disqualifier
      ,HMCProspectID2
      ,affiliateID2
      ,disqualifier2
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as Channel
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate

   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier

                    fl.inquiry_method,

select `DateID`,
    `Date`,
    `ModDate`,
    `WeekStart`,
    `ModWeekStart`,
    `DayOfYear`,
    `DayOfMonth`,
    `DayOfWeek`,
    `WeekDayName`,
    `Month`,
    `MonthName`,
    `Year`,
    `ModYear`,
    `ModMonthYear`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `MonthYearID`,
    cast({ fn year(`ModDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002 + cast({ fn month(`ModDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS
(
SELECT DateID
      ,Date
	  ,CASE WHEN DayOfWeek = 2 THEN Date 
	  WHEN DayOfWeek > 2 THEN DATEADD(day, 2- DayOfWeek,Date)
	  ELSE DATEADD(day, -6,Date)
	  END as WeekStart
      ,DayOfYear
      ,DayOfMonth
      ,DayOfWeek
      ,WeekDayName
      ,Month
      ,MonthName
      ,Year
	  ,Year(Getdate()) as ModYear
	  ,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year(Getdate())) as ModMonthYear
,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year) AS MonthYear
      ,MonthYearID
  FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
  WHERE  DateID Between Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric) and Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric)
  )

  SELECT CTE.DateID
      ,CTE.Date
	  ,CASE WHEN CTE.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) THEN DATEADD(YEAR, 1, CTE.Date) 
	  ELSE CTE.Date
	  END as ModDate
	  ,CTE.WeekStart
	  ,COALESCE(cte2.WeekStart, CTE.WeekStart) as ModWeekStart
      ,CTE.DayOfYear
      ,CTE.DayOfMonth
      ,CTE.DayOfWeek
      ,CTE.WeekDayName
      ,CTE.Month
      ,CTE.MonthName
      ,CTE.Year
	  ,CTE.ModYear
	  ,CTE.ModMonthYear
,CTE.MonthYear
      ,CTE.MonthYearID
  FROM CTE 
  LEFT JOIN CTE cte2 on CTE.DayOfYear = cte2.DayOfYear AND cte2.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) AND CTE.Year = Year(Getdate())
) as `_`

select `Name`,
    `emailaddress`,
    `phonenumber`,
    `postalcode`,
    `djtype`,
    `djreferral`,
    `referralid`,
    `providerid`,
    `referraldate`,
    `hmcrequestid`,
    `Providers_Referred`,
    `ActivatedOn`,
    `Cornerstone_Activation`,
    `AnyActivation`,
    `Cornerstone_HotTransfer`,
    `Any_HotTransfer`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS( 
      Select hmcr.hmcrequestid 
      ,ref.referralid
      ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate 
      ,CASE When ref.activatedon is not null then "Yes" else "No" end Cornerstone_Activation
      ,concat(hmcr.firstname, " ", hmcr.lastname)  Name 
      ,hmcr.emailaddress
      ,hpn.phonenumber
      ,ref.providerid 
      ,hmcr.postalcode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,case when ref.digitaljourney is not null then "Yes" else "No" end DJReferral
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
 JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
 JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ref.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequestphonenumber hpn on hpn.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  where p.providerorganizationid = 123 
   and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
   and ref.referredon >= '2026'

)

,CTEA AS( 
      Select CTE.HMCREQUESTID
            ,count(distinct ref.referralid) Providers_Referred
    FROM CTE 
     JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = cte.hmcrequestid
     JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid
      group by 1
)
,CTEB AS (
      Select CTE.HMCRequestID 
            ,case when p.providerorganizationid = 123 and ref.activatedon is not null then "Yes" else "No" end Cornerstone_Activation
            ,case when ref.activatedon is not null then "Yes" else "No" end AnyActivation
            ,ref.activatedon
      FROM CTE 
     JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = cte.hmcrequestid
     JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid
     LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ref.providerid
)
,CTEC AS( 
      Select CTE.HMCRequestID 
            ,case when p.providerorganizationid = 123 then 'Yes' else 'No' end Cornerstone_HotTransfer
      FROM CTE 
     JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = cte.hmcrequestid
     JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid
     JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid
     LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ref.providerid      
      where htr.hottransferresponseid = 1
)

Select DISTINCT CTE.Name 
      ,CTE.emailaddress
      ,CTE.phonenumber
      ,cte.postalcode
      ,cte.djtype
      ,cte.djreferral
      ,cte.referralid
      ,cte.providerid
      ,cte.referraldate
      ,cte.hmcrequestid
      ,CTEA.Providers_Referred
      ,CTEB.ActivatedOn

      ,CASE WHEN ctec.cornerstone_hottransfer is null then 'No' else 'Yes' end Cornerstone_HotTransfer
      ,case when ctec.hmcrequestid is null then 'No' else 'Yes' end as Any_HotTransfer

 LEFT JOIN CTEB on CTEB.hmcrequestid = cte.hmcrequestid
 LEFT JOIN CTEC on CTEc.hmcrequestid = cte.hmcrequestid

    `Name_join`,

from

    WITH CTE1 AS (
      WITH CTE AS (
      SELECT Concat(AgentFirstName, " ",AgentLastName) AgentName
      ,date_format(AgentStateTime,"HH") Hour
      ,date_format(AgentStateTime,"mm") minutes
      ,date_format(AgentStateTime,"ss") seconds
      ,agentstatetime
      ,To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') DetailDate 
       ,CASE WHEN Agent = 'leebasara.exito@aplaceformom.com' THEN 'sarae' 
             WHEN Agent = 'gregory.alsola@aplaceformom.com' THEN 'grega'
          ELSE LOWER(CONCAT(LEFT(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)-1),SUBSTRING(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)+1,1))) END AS name_join
 FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_import.five9dailyagentstatedetails
  WHERE detaildate >= '2025/01/01' and agentstatetime <> '24:00:00' and agentgroup = 'AC HCAM' 
  and state not in ('Login', 'Logout')
  ORDER BY AgentStateDetailId DESC
)

Select AgentName
      ,DetailDate
      ,Name_join 
      ,(hour*3600)+(minutes * 60) + seconds Duration 
      ,agentstatetime
FROM CTE 
)

Select AgentName
      ,DetailDate
      ,Name_join 
      ,CASE WHEN sum(duration) between 0 and 1800 then '< 5 Hours'
            WHEN sum(duration) between 1801 and 21600 then '< 5-6 Hours'
            WHEN sum(duration) between 21601 and 25200 then '< 6-7 Hours'
            WHEN sum(duration) between 25201 and 28800 then '< 7-8 Hours'
            WHEN sum(duration) between 28801 and 30600 then '< 8-8.5 Hours'
            WHEN sum(duration) > 30600 then '>8.5'
      else sum(duration) end HoursWorked 
FROM CTE1
GROUP BY AgentName, DetailDate, Name_join
) as `_`
limit 1000

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
    ,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

SElect *,
    date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',createdate)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour,
    HOUR(createdate) AS RequestHour,
    CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
    ELSE 0 END as DuringOperatingHours
FROM CTE 
Where rn =1
order by hmcrequestid desc
) as `_`

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `hmcprospectid`,
    `postalcode`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `requeststatuscode`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `AttemptCount`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `Note`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `hmcscreenqueueid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `hours`,
    `minute`,
    `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
    `rn`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `C1`,
    `C2`,
    `C2` - `C1` as `C3`
from 
(
    select `hmcrequestid`,
        `hmcprospectid`,
        `postalcode`,
        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `requeststatuscode`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `Adjust_CreateDate`,
        `AttemptCount`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `Note`,
        `affiliateID`,
        `hmcscreenqueueid`,
        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `djstepid`,
        `DJType`,
        `hours`,
        `minute`,
        `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
        `rn`,
        `RequestHalfHour`,
        `RequestHour`,
        `DuringOperatingHours`,
        (cast(year(`createdate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(10000 as DOUBLE) + cast(month(`createdate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(100 as DOUBLE)) + cast(dayofmonth(`createdate`) as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast(year(`ScreeningDate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(10000 as DOUBLE) + cast(month(`ScreeningDate`) as DOUBLE) * cast(100 as DOUBLE)) + cast(dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 

    ,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= dateadd(month, -7,getdate()) AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

SElect *,
    date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',createdate)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour,
    HOUR(createdate) AS RequestHour,
    CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
    ELSE 0 END as DuringOperatingHours
FROM CTE 
Where rn =1
order by hmcrequestid desc
    ) as `_`
) as `ITBL`
limit 1000

    `Note`,

      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,concat(hmcr.firstname, " ", hmcr.lastname) ContactName 
      ,date(hmcr.createdate) RequestCreateDate 
      ,hpn.phonenumber
      ,1 as Lead

      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.requeststatusid = 2 then 1 else 0 end RL 
      ,pn.note
      ,date(sr.createdate) ScreeningDate 
      ,sr.AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,concat("https://admin.agingcare.com/HMCLeadQueue/Home/Prospect/", hmcr.hmcprospectid) ProspectLink 
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc ) rn
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectphonenumber hpn on hpn.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes pn on pn.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr.*,ref.referredon,datediff(minute,LAG(sr.createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid),sr.createdate), LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24)
                      ,CASE WHEN sr.userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(sr.createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid),sr.createdate) < 480
                               AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) 
                                THEN 1 
                              when sr.userid = 1702946 
                               and date_format(sr.createdate, "MMM-dd-yy HH:mm:ss") > date_format(ref.referredon, "MMM-dd-yy HH:mm:ss") then 1
                               ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute

              left join main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = sr.hmcrequestid
              left join main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid

   WHERE hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141)

(

			 ,CASE WHEN AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-01-01' AND IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42         
			  WHEN AccountID = 2426 AND Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-01-01' AND IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42

      ,trim(hmcr.postalcode) postalcode
      ,msa_name
      ,cast(hmcr.createdate as date) createdate
        ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132) THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,136,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 THEN 'SEO'    
          WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
      END as AdjChannel 
      ,CASE WHEN temp.postalcode IS NOT NULL then hmcr.hmcrequestid else null
       END MontlyCapped 
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_dbo.zip_to_msa msa on trim(msa.zip_code) = trim(hmcr.Postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_geo.stateprovince sp on sp.stateprovinceid = pc.stateprovinceid
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_geo.city ci on ci.cityid = pc.cityid
LEFT JOIN (Select distinct date
      ,cte.providerid
      ,providername
      ,psc.postalcode
      ,orderid
      ,orderstatusreason
            FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cte
            LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cte.providerid
            LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on cte.providerid = psc.providerid
            WHERE orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached'
            and p.deleted = 0
            and psc.deleted =0) temp on trim(temp.postalcode) = trim(hmcr.postalcode) and cast(temp.date as date) = cast(hmcr.createdate as date)

WHERE hmcr.requeststatusid = 6
 and hmcr.createdate >= dateadd(day, -90, date(getdate())) and hmcr.createdate < date(getdate())
 
)

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `DJType`,
    `SourceP`,
    `C1`,
    `C2`,
    `C2` - `C1` as `C3`
from 
(
    select `hmcrequestid`,
        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `AdjChannel`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `DJType`,
        `SourceP`,
        (cast({ fn year(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on a.affiliateID = hmcr.affiliateid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

When AgentName = 'Kate Cruz' THEN 'kate.cruz'

    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `ScreeningHour`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `SecondstoFirstScreen`
from 
(
    WITH CTE (Select DISTINCT hmcr.hmcrequestid 
        ,dateadd(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate) ScreeningStartDateTime
	  ,DATEDIFF(second, hmcr.createdate, DATEADD(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate)) FirstScreeningLagSeconds
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as AdjChannel
       ,hmcr.requeststatusid
       ,sr.outcomeid
       ,case when hmcr.djstepid = 100 then 'Completed DJ'
            when hmcr.djstepid <> 100 and hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Dropped From DJ'
            else "Not DJ"
            end DJStep
      ,case when hmcr.djtypeid is not null then 'Offered DJ'
       else 'Not Offered DJ'
       end DJ
       ,sr.createdate AS ScreeningDateTime
       ,hmcr.postalcode
       ,hmcr.createdate As RequestDateTime
       ,tz.systimezone
        ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid

select `ProviderID`,

    `LastActiveDate`,
    `CurrentOrderStatus`,
    `CurrentOrderStatusReasonType`,
    `HCAM`,
    `CSM`,
    `postalcodeid`,
    `PostalCode`,
    `name`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS(

SELECT cph.ProviderID
        ,cph.ProviderName
        ,cph.OrderID
        ,o.createdon AS OrderCreateDate
        ,MIN(Date) AS FirstActiveDate
        ,Max(date) AS LastActiveDate
        ,ost.name As CurrentOrderStatus
        ,osrt.name As CurrentOrderStatusReasonType
        ,u2.FirstName AS HCAM
        ,u.FirstName AS CSM
          ,p.postalcodeid
       
               ,CASE WHEN dpc.code is null then p.postalcode ELSE dpc.code END AS PostalCode
FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.`order` o ON o.orderid = cph.OrderID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost ON ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
LEFT JOIN  prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt ON osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid

LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = AccountSpecialistUserID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u2 ON u2.UserID = HCAMUserID
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode dpc on dpc.postalcodeid = p.postalcodeid 
 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a.AccountID, u2.FirstName AS HCAM
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op ON op.ProviderID = p.ProviderID
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.OrderID = op.OrderID
				   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.account a ON a.AccountID = o.AccountID
