select `SLRl`,
    `hmcrequestid`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `DJType`,
    `SourceP`,
    `C1`,
    `C2`,
    `C2` - `C1` as `C3`
from 
(
    select `SLRl`,
        `hmcrequestid`,
        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `AdjChannel`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `DJType`,
        `SourceP`,
        (cast({ fn year(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign
                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'
                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on a.affiliateID = hmcr.affiliateid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (15,19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
      AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)
,CTEAA AS(
       SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY createdate desc) srn 
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr

                               AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24)

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `requeststatusid`,
    `Disqualifier`,
    `createdate`,
    `WhenCareNeeded`,
    `LessThan30Days`,
    `HT`,
    `ReferralID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `billingtypeid`,
    `providerid`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `Org`,
    `activatedon`,
    `ToActivation`,
    `returnapproved`
from 
(
    Select hmcr.hmcrequestid  
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.disqualifier is null then 0 
            ELSE 1 
            END Disqualifier
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 1 then "Immediately"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 2 then "Within 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 3 then "Greater than 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 4 then "Unsure"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 5 then "Within 7 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 6 then "No rush"
            else null
            END WhenCareNeeded
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid in (1,2,5) then 1
            ELSE 0
            END LessThan30Days
     ,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
     ,ref.ReferralID 
     ,ref.ReferredOn
     ,ref.billingtypeid
     ,ref.providerid
     ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
     ,p.Name ProviderName
     ,po.name Org
     ,ref.activatedon
     ,CASE WHEN ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,1,ref.ReferredOn) then 1
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,1,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn)) then 2
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn)) then 3
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,4,ReferredOn)) then 4
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,4,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,5,ReferredOn)) then 5
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,5,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,6,ReferredOn)) then 6
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,6,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,7,ReferredOn)) then 7
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,7,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,8,ReferredOn)) then 8
           WHEN ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,8,ReferredOn) then 9
           else Null
           End ToActivation
     ,ref.returnapproved
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequestphonenumber hmcrp on hmcrp.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid

from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
  WITH CTE1 AS( 
   WITH CTE AS( 
  Select case when state in ('Ringing', 'On Call') then 'On Call' else 'Ready' end UpdatedStatus, *, (date_format(cast(agentstatetime as timestamp), 'mm') * 60)+ (date_format(cast(agentstatetime as timestamp), 'ss')) Duration
  ,CASE WHEN Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Leeba Sara Exito' THEN 'sarae' 
                     When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Gregory Alsola' THEN 'grega'
When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Kate Cruz' THEN 'kate.cruz'
When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Rose Emilia' then 'roseem'
                     ELSE LOWER(CONCAT(LEFT(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)-1),SUBSTRING(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)+1,1))) 
                     END AS name_join
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_import.five9dailyagentstatedetails
where To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') >= '2025-06-01'
and agentgroup = 'AC Care Advisors'
--and agent = ('abner.pontino@aplaceformom.com')
 and state not in ('Logout' ,'Login' )
 and agentstatetime <> '00:00:00'
order by detaildate, time
)

  SELECT To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') Date
        ,Time
        ,agentstatetime
        ,agent
        ,updatedstatus
        ,duration
        ,name_join
        ,if(LAG(updatedstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY detaildate, agent ORDER BY To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), time) is null, updatedstatus, LAG(updatedstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY detaildate, agent ORDER BY To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), time)) AS prev_value 
  FROM CTE
)

  ,flags AS (
  SELECT Date
         ,time
         ,agentstatetime
         ,agent,updatedstatus
         ,duration
         ,name_join
         ,CASE WHEN updatedstatus = prev_value THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_new
  FROM cte1
  )

  SELECT 
  Date, time, agentstatetime, agent,updatedstatus, duration,name_join,
  SUM(is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY date, agent ORDER BY date,time) AS group_id
FROM flags
)

        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`

            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *

			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0

      ,hmcr.requeststatusid

      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'

            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'

      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid

      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

select `hmcrequestid`,

    `ReferralID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `billingtypeid`,
    `providerid`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `Org`,
    `activatedon`,
    `ToActivation`,
    `returnapproved`
from 
(
    Select hmcr.hmcrequestid  
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.disqualifier is null then 0 
            ELSE 1 
            END Disqualifier
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 1 then "Immediately"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 2 then "Within 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 3 then "Greater than 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 4 then "Unsure"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 5 then "Within 7 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 6 then "No rush"
            else null
            END WhenCareNeeded
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid in (1,2,5) then 1
            ELSE 0
            END LessThan30Days
     ,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
     ,ref.ReferralID 
     ,ref.ReferredOn
     ,ref.billingtypeid
     ,ref.providerid
     ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
     ,p.Name ProviderName
     ,po.name Org
     ,ref.activatedon
     ,CASE WHEN ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,1,ref.ReferredOn) then 1
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,1,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn)) then 2
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn)) then 3
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,4,ReferredOn)) then 4
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,4,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,5,ReferredOn)) then 5
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,5,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,6,ReferredOn)) then 6
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,6,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,7,ReferredOn)) then 7
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,7,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,8,ReferredOn)) then 8
           WHEN ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,8,ReferredOn) then 9
           else Null
           End ToActivation
     ,ref.returnapproved

 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequestphonenumber hmcrp on hmcrp.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid

    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    `ReturnApproved`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `ReferralRevenue`
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,r.activatedon
      ,DATE(r.activatedon) AS ActivatedOnDate
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `Date`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on year(cte.date) = year(cph.date) and if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
   and cph.orderid = 2774
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

Select Date 
      ,date_format(date, 'yyyyMM') MonthYear
      ,Org
      ,sum(cap) Adjust_MonthlyCap
      ,Count(distinct orderid) Orders
FROM CTE2
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
) as `_`
limit 1000

                               AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24)

select `DateID`,
    `Date`,
    `ModDate`,
    `WeekStart`,
    `ModWeekStart`,
    `DayOfYear`,
    `DayOfMonth`,
    `DayOfWeek`,
    `WeekDayName`,
    `Month`,
    `MonthName`,
    `Year`,
    `ModYear`,
    `ModMonthYear`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `MonthYearID`,
    `datediff(date, getdate())`,
    cast({ fn year(`ModDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002 + cast({ fn month(`ModDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS
(
SELECT DateID
      ,Date
	  ,CASE WHEN DayOfWeek = 2 THEN Date 
	  WHEN DayOfWeek > 2 THEN DATEADD(day, 2- DayOfWeek,Date)
	  ELSE DATEADD(day, -6,Date)
	  END as WeekStart
      ,DayOfYear
      ,DayOfMonth
      ,DayOfWeek
      ,WeekDayName
      ,Month
      ,MonthName
      ,Year
	  ,Year(Getdate()) as ModYear
	  ,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year(Getdate())) as ModMonthYear
,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year) AS MonthYear
      ,MonthYearID
  FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
  WHERE  DateID Between Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric) and Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric)
  )

  SELECT CTE.DateID
      ,CTE.Date
	  ,CASE WHEN CTE.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) THEN DATEADD(YEAR, 1, CTE.Date) 
	  ELSE CTE.Date
	  END as ModDate
	  ,CTE.WeekStart
	  ,COALESCE(cte2.WeekStart, CTE.WeekStart) as ModWeekStart
      ,CTE.DayOfYear
      ,CTE.DayOfMonth
      ,CTE.DayOfWeek
      ,CTE.WeekDayName
      ,CTE.Month
      ,CTE.MonthName
      ,CTE.Year
	  ,CTE.ModYear
	  ,CTE.ModMonthYear
,CTE.MonthYear
      ,CTE.MonthYearID
      ,datediff(cte.date, getdate())
  FROM CTE 
  LEFT JOIN CTE cte2 on CTE.DayOfYear = cte2.DayOfYear AND cte2.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) AND CTE.Year = Year(Getdate())
) as `_`

,hmcr.affiliateinquiryid

WHEN affiliateID = 93 THEN 'LNSTF'

WHEN affiliateID = 99 THEN 'LNSTF - MaxZip'
WHEN affiliateID = 106 THEN 'SLADQ - WT'
WHEN affiliateID = 108 THEN 'No Tours'

WHEN affiliateID = 117 THEN 'Resistant to Referral'
WHEN affiliateID = 119 THEN 'SLA DQ LP'
WHEN affiliateID = 121 THEN 'HC Max Attempts'

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `ScreeningStartDateTime`,
    `FirstScreeningLagSeconds`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `requeststatusid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `ScreeningDateTime`,
    `postalcode`,
    `RequestDateTime`,
    `systimezone`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `ScreeningHour`,
    `TOD`,
    `CreateDate`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `SecondstoFirstScreen`,
    `Delayed60`,
    `Delayed180`
from 
(
    WITH CTE (Select DISTINCT hmcr.hmcrequestid 
        ,dateadd(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate) ScreeningStartDateTime
	  ,DATEDIFF(second, hmcr.createdate, DATEADD(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate)) FirstScreeningLagSeconds
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
          --  WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 107 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,113,133,107 ) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            --WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as AdjChannel
       ,hmcr.requeststatusid
       ,sr.outcomeid
       ,sr.createdate AS ScreeningDateTime
       ,hmcr.postalcode
       ,hmcr.createdate As RequestDateTime
       ,tz.systimezone
        ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,secondsinprospect
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (14,15) 
                        AND secondsinprospect is not null 
                        and attemptcount = 1
                        and createdate >= '2024-08-01' ) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
Where hmcr.createdate >= '2024-08-01' )

SELECT *
      , CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
ELSE 0 
END as DuringOperatingHours
,HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) AS RequestHour
,HOUR(ScreeningDateTime) AS ScreeningHour
,CASE WHEN HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (8,9,10,11) then 'Morning'
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (12,1,2,3,4) then 'Afternoon'
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (5,6,7,8) then 'Evening'
      else 'Other'
      end TOD
,date(adjust_createdate) CreateDate
,date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',RequestDateTime)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour
,DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) AS SecondstoFirstScreen
,case when DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) > 60 then hmcrequestid else null end as Delayed60
,case when DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) > 180 then hmcrequestid else null end as Delayed180
FROM CTE
WHERE AdjChannel NOT IN ('APFM','APFM DQ') AND FirstScreeningLagSeconds IS NOT NULL
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `ReferralID`,

    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `activatedon`,
    `ActivatedOnDate`,
    `Activations`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    cast(`ReturnApproved` as BIGINT) as `C2`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `Providername`,
    `ReferralRevenue`,
    `ReturnApproved` as `C1`

    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID

      ,ReferralStatusTypeID

      ,DATE(r.activatedon) AS ActivatedOnDate

,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral

			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42

			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate

      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid

      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'

  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY createdate desc) srn

select `ProviderID`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `OrderID`,
    `ProviderOrderID`,
    `OrderStatus`,
    `OrderStatusReason`,
    `Close_Date`,
    `FirstActiveDate`,
    `LastActiveDate`,
    `DaysActive`,
    `Status`,
    `FirstActivation`,
    `HasActivation`,
    `FirstCaseDate`,
    `ProviderOrder_Age`
from 
(
    WITH CTE3 AS( 
  WITH CTE2 AS( 
  WITH CTE1 AS( 
  WITH CTE AS( 
  Select o.id OpportunityID 
      ,o.close_date
      ,a.hmc_cart_provider_id_c ProviderID 
FROM main.community_salesforce.opportunity o 
 JOIN main.community_salesforce.account a on a.id = o.account_id 
 WHERE o.is_won = true
  and o.close_date >= '2025-10-01'
 -- and a.hmc_cart_provider_id_c = 40382
) 

,CTEA1 AS (
Select CTE.ProviderID 
      ,p.name ProviderName 
      ,cph.OrderID 
      ,CTE.close_date
      ,cph.date
      ,cph.orderstatus
      ,lag(cph.orderstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY cte.providerid, cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.date) Lag 
FROM CTE 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cph.providerid =cte.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cte.providerid
  WHERE date >= '2022'
   and cph.contracttype = 'CPL'
   --and p.providerorganizationid is null 
   and cph.date >= '2025-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
)

 ,CTEC AS(
   Select DISTINCT CTEA1.ProviderID 
      ,p.name ProviderName 
      ,cph.OrderID 
      ,CTEA1.close_date
      ,min(cph.date) FirstActiveDate
      ,max(cph.date) LastActiveDate 
FROM CTEA1
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cph.providerid =ctea1.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ctea1.providerid
  WHERE cph.date >= '2022'
   and cph.contracttype = 'CPL'
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   --and p.providerorganizationid is null 
   and cph.date >= '2025-10-01'
   and if(ctea1.orderstatus = 'Onboarding', ctea1.lag <> ctea1.orderstatus, ctea1.orderstatus = ctea1.orderstatus)
 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4  
 )

 Select DISTINCT CTE.ProviderID 
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.OrderID is null then op.orderid else CTEC.OrderID end OrderID  
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.ProviderName is null then p.name else CTEC.ProviderName end ProviderName 
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.Close_Date is null then CTE.Close_Date else CTEC.Close_Date end close_date
       ,CTEC.firstactivedate
       ,CTEC.lastactivedate
      FROM CTE     
     LEFT JOIN CTEC on CTEC.ProviderID = CTE.ProviderID 
     LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cte.providerid 
     LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.providerid = cte.providerid
  )

,CTEB AS(
Select CTE1.ProviderID 
      ,CTE1.ProviderName 
      ,CTE1.OrderID
      ,concat(CTE1.ProviderID, "-", CTE1.OrderID) ProviderOrderID 
      ,CASE WHEN cph.orderstatus is null then ost.name else cph.orderstatus end OrderStatus

            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'

            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'

            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `affiliateid`,
    `DJType`,
    `SourceP`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'

  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *

WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'

select `HMCRequestID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `Flow`,
    `lastoutcomeid`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `Channel`,
    `IsDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `Source`,

    `RequestDateTime`,
    `RequestStatusID`,
    `Lead`,
    `LSTF`,

from 
(
    WITH CTE3 AS
(WITH CTE2 AS 
(WITH CTE AS 
(SELECT distinct hmcr.HMCRequestID
,hmcr.HMCProspectID
,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow =1 then 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Flow
  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'

            ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END as AdjChannel

,hmcr.affiliateID
,hmcr.requeststatusid 
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute

,aff.affiliatename
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'

select `HMCRequestID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `Flow`,
    `lastoutcomeid`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `dma`,
    `Channel`,
    `IsDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `Source`,
    `formname`,
    `TimeID`,
    `SiteSection`,
    `SEMForm`,
    `EmailType`,
    `RequestDateTime`,
    `RequestStatusID`,
    `Lead`,
    `LSTF`,
    `RL`,
    `CampaignID`,
    `CampaignName`
from 
(
    WITH CTE3 AS
(WITH CTE2 AS 
(WITH CTE AS 
(SELECT distinct hmcr.HMCRequestID
,hmcr.HMCProspectID
,hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
,apfm.lt_form_submit_channel
,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow =1 then 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Flow
,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
 WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
 WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE 'Affiliates'
END as AdjChannel
,hmcr.affiliateID
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute TimeID
,hmcr.url
,dma
,aff.affiliatename
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
,sr.outcomeid
,formname
      ,CAST(hmcr.createdate as date) AS RequestDateTime
	  ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
	  ,1 as Lead
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =6 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as LSTF
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =2 then 1 else 0 END as RL
    ,DMA 
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate aff on aff.affiliateid = hmcr.affiliateid
LEFT JOIN main.reporting.dim_geography_zip_dma dma on dma.zip = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign

                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2022-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL) and   dma in ('Boston', 'Houston', 'Atlanta')
  )

When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Kate Cruz' THEN 'kate.cruz'
When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Rose Emilia' then 'roseem'
                     ELSE LOWER(CONCAT(LEFT(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)-1),SUBSTRING(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)+1,1))) 
                     END AS name_join
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_import.five9dailyagentstatedetails
where To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') >= date_add(Year, -1, date_trunc("Month",getdate())) and agentgroup = 'AC Care Advisors'

        ,Time
        ,agentstatetime
        ,agent
        ,updatedstatus
        ,duration
        ,name_join
        ,if(LAG(updatedstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY detaildate, agent ORDER BY To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), time) is null, updatedstatus, LAG(updatedstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY detaildate, agent ORDER BY To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), time)) AS prev_value 
  FROM CTE
)

  ,flags AS (
  SELECT Date
         ,time
         ,agentstatetime
         ,agent,updatedstatus
         ,duration
         ,name_join
         ,CASE WHEN updatedstatus = prev_value THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_new

  SELECT 
  Date, time, agentstatetime, agent,updatedstatus, duration,name_join,

      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
     -- WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate

      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note

      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'

,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid

      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc ) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr.*,ref.referredon,datediff(minute,LAG(sr.createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid),sr.createdate), LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24)
                      ,CASE WHEN sr.userid = 1702946

                               AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24)

 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'

			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0

from 
(
    WITH CTE AS (
      Select distinct hmcr.hmcrequestid 
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,trim(hmcr.postalcode) postalcode
      ,msa_name
      ,cast(hmcr.createdate as date) createdate
        ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132) THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,136,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 THEN 'SEO'    
          WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
      END as AdjChannel 
      ,CASE WHEN temp.postalcode IS NOT NULL then hmcr.hmcrequestid else null
       END MontlyCapped 
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_dbo.zip_to_msa msa on trim(msa.zip_code) = trim(hmcr.Postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_geo.stateprovince sp on sp.stateprovinceid = pc.stateprovinceid

            LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on cte.providerid = psc.providerid
            WHERE orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached'
            and p.deleted = 0
            and psc.deleted =0) temp on trim(temp.postalcode) = trim(hmcr.postalcode) and cast(temp.date as date) = cast(hmcr.createdate as date)

WHERE hmcr.requeststatusid = 6
 and hmcr.createdate >= dateadd(day, -90, date(getdate())) and hmcr.createdate < date(getdate())

 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"

      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'

      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'

select `SLRl`,

    `DJStep`,

from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr

  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,

                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,

                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign

                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute

WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL)

        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`

WITH CTE AS (

 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'

      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
     -- WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'

      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'

      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

select `ProviderID`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `OrderID`,
    `OrderCreateDate`,
    `LastDay`,
    `FirstActiveDate`,
    `LastActiveDate`,
    `CurrentOrderStatus`,
    `CurrentOrderStatusReasonType`,
    `HCAM`,
    `CSM`,
    `providerorders`,
    `DaystoCancel`,
    `Attrition`,
    `Retention`,
    `rn`,
    `prepaid`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS (
      SELECT cph.ProviderID
        ,p.name ProviderName
        ,cph.OrderID
        ,o.createdon AS OrderCreateDate
        ,last_day(cph.date) LastDay
        ,MIN(Date) AS FirstActiveDate
        ,Max(date) AS LastActiveDate
        ,ost.name As CurrentOrderStatus
        ,osrt.name As CurrentOrderStatusReasonType
        ,u2.FirstName AS HCAM
        ,u.FirstName AS CSM
FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.`order` o ON o.orderid = cph.OrderID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost ON ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
LEFT JOIN  prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt ON osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = cph.ProviderID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = AccountSpecialistUserID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u2 ON u2.UserID = HCAMUserID
WHERE Date >= '2019-01-01' and (cph.orderstatus = 'Active' OR cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' OR cph.orderstatus = 'Paused')
GROUP BY cph.ProviderID,p.name,cph.OrderID,o.createdon,ost.name,osrt.name,u2.FirstName,u.FirstName,last_day(cph.date)
)

Select CTE.*
       , concat(providerid, "-",cte.orderid) providerorders 
       ,datediff(LastActiveDate, firstactivedate) DaystoCancel
       ,case when CurrentOrderStatusReasonType = 'Monthly Cap Reached' then 0 
             when o.orderid is not null and CurrentOrderStatusReasonType ='InsufficientBalance' then 0 
             when CurrentOrderStatus in ('Suspended', 'Cancelled') then 1 
             else 0 end Attrition
        ,case when CurrentOrderStatus in ('Active', 'Paused') or CurrentOrderStatusReasonType = 'Monthly Cap Reached' then 1 
         when o.orderid is not null and CurrentOrderStatusReasonType ='InsufficientBalance' then 1
         else 0 end Retention
        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY concat(providerid, "-",cte.orderid) ORDER BY lastactivedate desc) rn
        ,case when o.orderid is null then 0 else 1 end prepaid
FROM CTE
LEFT JOIN ( 
  Select orderid 
        ,prepaidtotal
  FROM main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order
  where prepaidtotal >= 580) o on o.orderid = cte.orderid 
where lastday > '2025-07-01'
) as `_`

      ,CTE.OrderStatus CurrentOrderStatus
      ,CTE.OrderStatusReason CurrentOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.OrderCreateDate
      ,CTE.HCAM 
      ,hcc.HomecareChargeID 
      ,hcc.amount 
      ,hcc.createdon ChargeCreateDate
      ,cph.orderstatus CPHOrderStatus
      ,cph.orderstatusreason CPHOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.prepaidautorenew
      ,cte.prepaidtotal
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hcc.homecarechargeid ORDER BY cph.cartproviderhistoryid desc) as RN
      ,LagDate
      ,his.orderstatus LastOrderStatus
      ,his.orderstatusreason LastOrderStatusReason
      ,DateSuspended

 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.referralid = ref.referralid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cast(cph.date as date) = cast(add_months(hcc.createdon, 1) as date) and cph.accountid = hcc.accountid and CTE.orderid = cph.orderid
 LEFT JOIN (Select distinct orderid, accountid,orderstatus, orderstatusreason, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY orderid ORDER BY Date desc) rn
           FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory) his on  his.accountid = cte.accountid and his.orderid = cte.orderid and his.rn = 1
 LEFT JOIN (Select distinct cph.*
                  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.Date desc) rn
                  ,LAG(cph.`date`,1 ) OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.date) LagDate
         FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
          LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid 
            WHERE cph.orderstatusreason = 'InsufficientBalance' and (o.prepaidtotal <580 or o.prepaidtotal is null)) temp on temp.accountid = cte.accountid and temp.orderid = cte.orderid and temp.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN (Select cph.*, date DateSuspended
                 ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.Date asc) rn
            FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
              LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid 
                WHERE cph.orderstatusreason = 'InsufficientBalance' and (o.prepaidtotal <580 or o.prepaidtotal is null) ) temp2 on temp2.accountid = cte.accountid and temp2.orderid = cte.orderid and temp2.rn = 1

        (cast({ fn year(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`

        WITH CTE2 AS (

WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'

      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

select `Date`,
    cast({ fn round(cast(`MonthYear` as DOUBLE), 0) } as BIGINT) as `C1`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on year(cte.date) = year(cph.date) and if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

Select Date 
      ,date_format(date, 'yyyyMM') MonthYear
      ,Org
      ,sum(cap) Adjust_MonthlyCap
      ,Count(distinct orderid) Orders
FROM CTE2
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
) as `_`

select `ProviderName`,

    `OrderName`,
    `orderid`,

    `DaysActive`,
    `CurrentOrderStatus`,

from 
(
    Select p.name ProviderName 
      ,p.providerid 
      ,o.name OrderName 
      ,o.orderid 
      ,concat(p.providerid, "-", o.orderid) ProviderOrder
      ,datediff(getdate(), o.createdon) DaysActive
      ,ost.name CurrentOrderStatus 
      ,osrt.name CurrentOrderReason 
FROM main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p 
 JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.providerid = p.providerid 
 JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = op.orderid
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost on ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt on osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
      WHERE date_diff(day,o.createdon, getdate()) <= 90
      and ost.name <> 'Onboarding'
      and p.providerorganizationid is null
) as `_`
limit 1000

from 
(
    WITH CTE3 AS
(WITH CTE2 AS 
(WITH CTE AS 
(SELECT distinct hmcr.HMCRequestID
,hmcr.HMCProspectID
,hmcr.postalcode
,hmcr.affiliateid
,hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
,apfm.lt_form_submit_channel

 WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
ELSE 'Affiliates'

,hmcr.affiliateID
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute TimeID
,hmcr.url
,aff.affiliatename
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'

      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
,sr.outcomeid
,formname
      ,CAST(hmcr.createdate as date) AS RequestDateTime
	  ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
	  ,1 as Lead
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =6 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as LSTF
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =2 then 1 else 0 END as RL
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate aff on aff.affiliateid = hmcr.affiliateid

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn

				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,

                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'

  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2022-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL) AND (hmcr.affiliateid <> 140 OR hmcr.postalcode <> 99732))

SELECT hmcr.HMCRequestID

      ,affiliateID2
      ,disqualifier2
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then 'Grace'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as Channel
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
 FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
   LEFT JOIN CTE1 on CTE1.hmcprospectid2 = hmcr.hmcprospectid 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign
                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

(
