    Select *, CASE WHEN date <'2025-11-01' then 'Pre Test' else 'Post Test' end as Test
FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
where date >= dateadd(Year, -1, date_trunc('YEAR',getdate()))
and date <= dateadd(Year,1,date_trunc('YEAR',getdate()))
) as `_`
order by `date`
limit 1000

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `AttemptCount`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `hmcscreenqueueid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `SourceP`,
    `C1`,
    `C2`,
    `C2` - `C1` as `C3`
from 
(
    select `hmcrequestid`,
        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `AdjChannel`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `Adjust_CreateDate`,
        `AttemptCount`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `hmcscreenqueueid`,
        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `djstepid`,
        `DJType`,
        `SourceP`,
        (cast({ fn year(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on a.affiliateID = hmcr.affiliateid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

SElect *
    ,CASE WHEN affiliateID = 87 THEN 'Convertful'
WHEN affiliateID = 92 THEN 'Typeform'
WHEN affiliateID = 90 THEN 'Elderlife'
WHEN affiliateID = 93 THEN 'LNSTF'
WHEN affiliateID = 94 THEN 'SLA DQ'
WHEN affiliateID = 95 THEN 'LNSTF - CN'
WHEN affiliateID = 96 THEN 'LNSTF - WS'
WHEN affiliateID = 97 THEN 'LNSTF Inbound'
WHEN affiliateID = 99 THEN 'LNSTF - MaxZip'
WHEN affiliateID = 106 THEN 'SLADQ - WT'

when affiliateID = 112 THEN 'APFM SEO'

WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEM' AND url like '%msclkid%' THEN 'SEM - Bing'

Select CTE2.*except (hmcprospectid, postalcode,affiliatename,url, requeststatuscode, rn,note,affiliateid,  source,campaign1, campaignid) ,CASE WHEN AdjChannel = "SEM" and CampaignID in (21152744542, 21149280686, 21142376391, 21142377831, 21142376379, 21149280908, 21149280227, 21152743894, 21149280179, 638388490, 638388484, 638388481, 638388480, 638388479, 638388478, 638388477, 638388476, 638388475, 638388474, 638388473, 638388472, 638388471, 638388470, 638388469, 638343060) then "Partner Campaigns"

select `referralid`,
    `orderid`,
    `Activated`,
    `ProviderOrder`,
    `providerid`,
    `OrderType`,
    `ReferralDate`
from 
(
    Select ref.referralid 
       ,ref.orderid 
       ,case when ref.activatedon is null then null else ref.referralid end Activated
       ,concat(ref.providerid, "-", ref.orderid) ProviderOrder
       ,ref.providerid 
       ,Case when ref.orderid = 3265 then 'Corporate Order' else 'Individual Order' end OrderType 
       ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate
FROM main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ref.providerid 
WHERE p.providerorganizationid = 7
 and ref.referredon >= '2025'
 and ref.billingtypeid = 3
 and ref.hmcleadid is not null
) as `_`

select `AgentStateDetailId`,

    `AgentGroup`,
    `Timeid`,
    `Time`,
    `EndTime`,
    `State`,
    `ReasonCode`,
    `MediaAvailability`,
    `SkillAvailability`,
    `WastedTime`,
    `AgentStateGroup`,
    `AgentStateTime`,
    `DetailDate`,
    `name_join`
from 
(
    SELECT AgentStateDetailId
      ,Agent
      ,AgentGroup
      ,date_format(Time,"HHmm") Timeid 
      ,Time
	  ,LAG(Time) OVER (PARTITION BY Agent ORDER BY AgentStateDetailId DESC) EndTime
      ,State
      ,ReasonCode
      ,MediaAvailability
      ,SkillAvailability
	  ,CASE WHEN State = 'After Call Work' OR (State= 'Not Ready' AND ReasonCode = 'Quality') THEN 'Wasted Time' ELSE '' END as WastedTime
	  ,CASE WHEN State = 'Not Ready' AND (ReasonCode IN ('Out of Office', 'Lunch', 'Break', 'Away from Desk_SLA', 'Logout')) THEN 'Away' ELSE 'Working' END as AgentStateGroup
      ,AgentStateTime
      ,DetailDate
       ,CASE WHEN Agent = 'leebasara.exito@aplaceformom.com' THEN 'sarae' 
             WHEN Agent = 'kate.cruz@aplaceformom.com' then 'kate.cruz'
             WHEN Agent = 'gregory.alsola@aplaceformom.com' THEN 'grega'
             WHEN Agent = 'rose.emilia@aplaceformom.com' THEN 'roseem'
          ELSE LOWER(CONCAT(LEFT(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)-1),SUBSTRING(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)+1,1))) END AS name_join
 FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_import.five9dailyagentstatedetails
  WHERE To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') >=  date_add(Year, -1, date_trunc("Month",getdate()))
    and agentstatetime <> '24:00:00'
    and AgentGroup = 'AC Care Advisors'
  ORDER BY AgentStateDetailId DESC
) as `_`
limit 1000

select * 
from 
(
    WITH CTE5 (WITH CTE4 (WITH CTE3 
    (WITH CTE2 
            -- Here I am generating the list of all providers who have had a suspensions due to payment failure on their account 
            (WITH CTE
                    (SELECT DISTINCT cph.providerid,
                                     cph.accountid,
                                            cph.Date,
                                           cast(o.createdon as date) OrderCreateDate,
                                            pay.amount,
                                        -- pay.`Date`,
                                            pay.paymentstatustypeid,
                                            LAG(cph.orderstatus) OVER(PARTITION BY cph.providerid ORDER BY cph.Date) AS PriorDayOrderStatus,
                                            LAG(cph.orderstatusreason) OVER(PARTITION BY cph.providerid ORDER BY cph.Date) AS PriorDayOrderStatusReason,
                                            LEAD(cph.orderstatus) OVER(PARTITION BY cph.providerid ORDER BY cph.Date) AS NextDayOrderStatus,
                                            LEAD(cph.orderstatusreason) OVER(PARTITION BY cph.providerid ORDER BY cph.Date) AS NextDayOrderStatusReason,
                                            cph.orderstatus,
                                            cph.orderstatusreason
                    FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
                    LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid 
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT paymentid,amount,DATE(createdon) AS Date,accountid,paymentstatustypeid,resultmessage
                                    FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.payment
                                    WHERE paymentstatustypeid = 2 and createdon >= '2023' AND (DAY(createdon) = 1 OR DATE(CreatedOn) = '2025-01-02')) pay ON pay.Date = cph.Date AND pay.accountid = cph.accountid
                    WHERE cph.Date >= '2023' AND ContractType = 'CPL')
-- This ss responsible for generating the most recent suspend date for each individual day the provider has been suspended
            SELECT DISTINCT cte.*, 
                    ls.LatestSuspendDate, 
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cte.providerid,cte.Date ORDER BY LatestSuspendDate desc) AS LatestCCFailure,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cte.providerid,cte.Date ORDER BY LatestSuspendDate) AS EarliestCCFailure
            FROM CTE 
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT providerid,Date AS LatestSuspendDate
                        FROM CTE 
                        WHERE paymentstatustypeid IS NOT NULL) as ls ON ls.providerid = CTE.providerid AND CTE.Date >= ls.LatestSuspendDate
            WHERE (paymentstatustypeid IS NOT NULL OR priordayorderstatusreason = 'Account Suspended') --and cte.providerid = 32279
            )
-- This next section gets the last suspended date due to payment failure (Date) and the day it was first suspended (LatestSuspendDate)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ProviderID,LatestSuspendDate ORDER BY Date desc) AS rn2
    FROM CTE2
    WHERE LatestCCFailure = 1 
    )

,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute TimeID
,hmcr.url
,aff.affiliatename
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
,sr.outcomeid
,formname
      ,CAST(hmcr.createdate as date) AS RequestDateTime
	  ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
	  ,1 as Lead
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =6 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as LSTF
	  ,CASE WHEN hmcr.RequestStatusID =2 then 1 else 0 END as RL
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate aff on aff.affiliateid = hmcr.affiliateid

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign

                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2022-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL) AND (hmcr.affiliateid <> 140 OR hmcr.postalcode <> 99732))

select `ProviderID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `ProviderOrders`,
    `FirstActive`,
    `LastActive`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `Org`,
    `OrderStatus`,
    `OrderStatusReason`,
    `ProviderCoverage`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS( 
     Select cph.providerid 
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,max(cph.date) LastActive 
      ,min(cph.date) FirstActive 
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
 WHERE (cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' or cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused'))
   and cph.contracttype = 'CPL'
 GROUP BY 1,2 
)

,CTEA AS (
     Select DISTINCT cph.providerid 
           ,cph.orderid 
           ,cph.orderstatus 
           ,cph.orderstatusreason 
    FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
    where date = date(getdate())
)

,CTEB1 AS ( 
       SELECT
    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)

,CTEB AS ( 
     Select psc.providerid 
           ,count(distinct psc.postalcode) ProviderPostalCode 
           ,count(distinct cteb1.zip5) Zip5Cov
           ,Zip5Cov/providerpostalcode ProviderCoverage 
    FROM main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc 
    LEFT JOIN CTEB1 on psc.postalcode = cteb1.zip5
    WHERE psc.deleted = 0 
     GROUP BY 1
)

Select CTE.ProviderID 
      ,CTE.OrderID 
      ,concat(CTE.ProviderID,'-',CTE.OrderID) ProviderOrders
      ,CTE.FirstActive 
      ,CTE.LastActive
      ,p.name ProviderName 
      ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent" else "Franchise"  END Org
      ,CASE WHEN CTEA.orderstatus is null then ost.name else ctea.orderstatus end OrderStatus 
      ,case when ctea.orderstatusreason is null then osrt.name else ctea.orderstatusreason end OrderStatusReason 
      ,ProviderCoverage
FROM CTE 
LEFT JOIN CTEA on CTEA.providerid = cte.providerid  and ctea.orderid = cte.orderid
JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on CTE.providerid = p.providerid
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cte.orderid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost on ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt on osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
LEFT JOIN CTEB on CTEB.providerid = CTE.providerid
) as `_`
limit 1000

      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  and p.providerorganizationid is not null 
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`

SELECT hmcr.HMCRequestID
      ,hmcr.HMCProspectID
      ,hmcpd.disqualifier
      ,HMCProspectID2
      ,affiliateID2
      ,disqualifier2
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as Channel
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
 FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
   LEFT JOIN CTE1 on CTE1.hmcprospectid2 = hmcr.hmcprospectid 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign
                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2024-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL)
)

    `CurrentOrderStatus`,
    `CurrentOrderStatusReasonType`,
    `HCAM`,
    `CSM`,
    `Days_Active`,

    WITH CTE AS(
    SELECT cph.ProviderID
        ,cph.ProviderName
        ,case when p.providerorganizationid IS NULL THEN 'Independent' ELSE 'Franchise' END AS ProviderType
        ,cph.OrderID

        ,MIN(Date) AS FirstActiveDate
        ,Max(date) AS LastActiveDate

        ,u2.FirstName AS HCAM
        ,u.FirstName AS CSM

SELECT hmcr.HMCRequestID

      ,HMCProspectID2
      ,affiliateID2
      ,disqualifier2
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as Channel
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
 FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
   LEFT JOIN CTE1 on CTE1.hmcprospectid2 = hmcr.hmcprospectid 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign
                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2024-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL)

select * 
from 
(
    with cte as ( 
  Select count(distinct referralid) Referrals 
      ,date(Referredon) ReferredOn 
      ,date_format(Referredon, 'yyyyMM') MonthYearID 
       ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = ref.providerid 
where hmcleadid is not null 
and ref.referredon >= '2025'
and ref.billingtypeid = 3
and (ref.returnapproved <> TRUE OR ref.returnapproved IS NULL)
GROUP BY 2,3,4
)

,CTEA AS (
Select ReferredOn
      ,MonthYearID 
      ,Org
      ,sum(Referrals) OVER (PARTITION BY MonthYearID, org order by ReferredOn) RunningReferrals 
  FROM CTE 
  group by referredon, monthyearid, referrals, org
)

Select CTE.*
      ,RunningReferrals 
  FROM CTE 
  LEFT JOIN CTEA on CTEA.Referredon = cte.referredon and ctea.org = cte.org
) as `_`
limit 0

      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'

  ,CASE WHEN Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Leeba Sara Exito' THEN 'sarae' 
                     When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Gregory Alsola' THEN 'grega'
When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Kate Cruz' THEN 'kate.cruz'
When Concat(agentfirstname, ' ',agentlastname) = 'Rose Emilia' then 'roseem'
                     ELSE LOWER(CONCAT(LEFT(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)-1),SUBSTRING(Agent,CHARINDEX('.',Agent)+1,1))) 
                     END AS name_join

where To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd') >= '2025-06-01'
and agentgroup = 'AC Care Advisors'

        ,agent
        ,updatedstatus
        ,duration
        ,name_join
        ,if(LAG(updatedstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY detaildate, agent ORDER BY To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), time) is null, updatedstatus, LAG(updatedstatus) OVER (PARTITION BY detaildate, agent ORDER BY To_date(detaildate, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), time)) AS prev_value 
  FROM CTE
)

  SELECT Date
         ,time
         ,agentstatetime
         ,agent,updatedstatus
         ,duration

         ,CASE WHEN updatedstatus = prev_value THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_new

  )

  Date, time, agentstatetime, agent,updatedstatus, duration,name_join,
  SUM(is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY date, agent ORDER BY date,time) AS group_id

(

    Select DISTINCT ref.leadid

     -- ,ref.referredon
      ,sum(CASE WHEN ref.activatedon is null then null 
            ELSE 1 
            END) Activated 
      ,Count(distinct ref.providerid) NumProv
      ,sum(CASE WHEN htr.hottransferresponseid = 1 then 1 
            ELSE null
            END) HT
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid 
  WHERE referredon >= '2024'
  GROUP BY ref.leadid
  ORDER BY ref.leadid
)

       ,ref.leadid 
      ,CASE WHEN CTE.Activated is null then 'No'
            ELSE 'Yes'
            END AnyActivations
      ,NumProv
      ,CASE WHEN HT is null then 'No' else 'Yes' end HT
      ,temp.Name HTProvider
      ,temp2.Activatedon

LEFT JOIN (Select p.name, ref.referralid, ref.leadid,htr.hottransferresponseid
                  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
                  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid

                  WHERE htr.hottransferresponseid = 1 and ref.referredon >= '2024' ) temp on temp.leadid = ref.leadid

          from prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
          where r.activatedon is not null ) temp2 on temp2.leadid = ref.leadid

ORDER BY ref.leadid
) as `_`

select `ProviderHistoryID`,
    `Date`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `AccountID`,
    `AccountStatusReasonTypeID`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `OrderName`,
    `AccountName`,
    `ContractType`,
    `OrderStatus`,
    `OrderStatusReason`,
    `MonthlyCap`,
    `MonthlySent`,
    `OrderCreateDate`,
    `CCFail`,
    `HCAM`,
    `CSM`,
    `rn`,
    `DaysSuspended`,
    `LagDate`,
    `DaysBetweenSusp`,
    `new_rn`,
    `FirstSusp`
from 
(
    WITH CTE4 AS (
    WITH CTE3 AS (
    WITH CTE2 AS(
     WITH CTE1 AS (
       WITH CTE AS (

SELECT ProviderHistoryID
      ,Date
      ,cph.ProviderID
      ,o.OrderID
      ,cph.AccountID
	  ,a.AccountStatusReasonTypeID
      ,ProviderName
      ,OrderName
      ,AccountName
      ,cph.ContractType
      ,OrderStatus
      ,OrderStatusReason
      ,cph.MonthlyCap
      ,cph.MonthlySent
	  ,o.CreatedOn AS OrderCreateDate
      ,CCFail
	  ,u2.FirstName AS HCAM
       ,u.FirstName AS CSM
	  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.ProviderID ORDER BY cph.Date) rn
	  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.ProviderID ORDER BY cph.Date desc) DaysSuspended
  FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.account a ON a.AccountID = cph.AccountID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o ON o.OrderID = cph.OrderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = cph.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = AccountSpecialistUserID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u2 ON u2.UserID = HCAMUserID
  WHERE a.AccountStatusReasonTypeID in (1,23) AND cph.ContractType = 'CPL' 
  AND OrderStatus = 'Suspended' AND OrderStatusReason = 'Account Suspended'
)



 

  SELECT *, LAG(Date) OVER (PARTITION BY ProviderID ORDER BY Date) AS LagDate
  FROM CTE
  ORDER BY ProviderID,Date
) 

  SELECT *, DATEDIFF(day,LagDate,Date) AS DaysBetweenSusp
  FROM CTE1
  WHERE DATEDIFF(day,LagDate,Date) > 1 OR LagDate IS NULL 
  ORDER BY ProviderID
) 

  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ProviderID ORDER BY Date desc) new_rn
  FROM CTE2
  ORDER BY ProviderID,Date
)

  SELECT *, LAG(Date) OVER (PARTITION BY ProviderID ORDER BY Date) as FirstSusp
  FROM CTE3
  WHERE rn = 1 OR new_rn = 1
  ORDER BY ProviderID,OrderID,Date desc
)

  SELECT *
  FROM CTE4 
  WHERE new_rn = 1
   and date >= '2025'
) as `_`

        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`

    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel

      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'

      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'

      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate

WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL)

	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,ProviderID
      ,BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
	  ,YEAR(ReferredOn) * 10000 + MONTH(ReferredOn) * 100 + DAY(ReferredOn) as ReferredOnDateID
	  ,ActivatedOn
	  ,StartedCareOn
	  ,EndedCareOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,ReturnApproved
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
	  ,hcc.EntryID
	  ,hcc.Amount as CPR_Revenue
	  ,CASE WHEN r.OrderID = 2774 then 34 
	  ELSE hcc.Amount END as CPL_Revenue
	  ,COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.ReferralID ORDER BY r.HMCLeadID DESC) ct
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HomeCareChargeID
				  ,AccountID
				  ,ReferralID
				  ,Amount
				  ,IsCredit
				  ,CreatedOn
				  ,EntryID
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ReferralID ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC) rn 
			  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge
			  WHERE IsCredit = 0) hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID and rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  WHERE 1=1
  AND ((BillingTypeID = 3 AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL))
  AND r.ReferredOn > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferralID desc
) as `_`
limit 0

select `Date`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

Select Date 
      ,date_format(date, 'yyyyMM') MonthYear
      ,Org
      ,sum(cap) Adjust_MonthlyCap
      ,Count(distinct orderid) Orders
FROM CTE2
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
) as `_`
limit 1000

     ,max(p.createdon) createdon

     ,p.createdon createdon

     ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY accountid, amount ORDER BY paymentid desc) rn
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.payment p 
  
)

               ,amount 
               ,paymentdate
          FROM CTEA
          WHERE (paymentstatustypeid = 1 and rn = 1)

      ,CTE.PaymentDate

 LEFT JOIN CTEB on CTEB.accountid = CTE.accountid and cte.paymentdate = cteb.paymentdate

WHEN r.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'

	  ,p.createdate Prospect_Date
    ,p.firstname
    ,p.lastname
    ,a.affiliatename
    ,ppn.phonenumber
	  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.HMCRequestID ORDER BY sr.createdate desc) as rn 
      ,p.Disqualifier
	  ,pd.Disqualifier as Disqualifer_Text
      ,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.DisqualifierReason, CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), ''),  CHAR(9), '') DisqualiferReason
	  ,'https://admin.agingcare.com/HMCLeadQueue/Home/Prospect/' 
    , p.hmcprospectid Url
    ,sr.userid
	  ,sr.createdate as Screen_Date
	  ,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(pn.Note, CHAR(10), ''), CHAR(13), ''),  CHAR(9), '') as Note
	  ,sr.outcomeid ScreeningOutcome
      ,p.postalcode
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect p
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier pd on pd.HMCProspectDisqualifierID = p.Disqualifier
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest r on r.HMCProspectID = p.HMCProspectID

  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on r.affiliateid = a.affiliateid

			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'

  where p.Disqualifier is not null
     and p.createdate >= '2024-01-01' 
	 and r.requeststatusid <> 2

select `ProviderID`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `OrderID`,
    `ProviderOrderID`,
    `OrderStatus`,
    `OrderStatusReason`,
    `Close_Date`,
    `FirstActiveDate`,
    `LastActiveDate`,
    `DaysActive`,
    `Status`,
    `FirstActivation`,
    `HasActivation`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
  WITH CTE1 AS( 
  WITH CTE AS( 
  Select o.id OpportunityID 
      ,o.close_date
      ,a.hmc_cart_provider_id_c ProviderID 
FROM main.community_salesforce.opportunity o 
 JOIN main.community_salesforce.account a on a.id = o.account_id 
 WHERE --o.is_won = true
  o.close_date >= '2025-10-01'
  --and a.hmc_cart_provider_id_c = 11257
) 

,CTEC AS( 
      Select CTE.ProviderID 
      ,p.name ProviderName 
      ,cph.OrderID 
      ,CTE.close_date
      ,min(date) FirstActiveDate
      ,max(date) LastActiveDate 
FROM CTE 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cph.providerid =cte.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cte.providerid
  WHERE date >= '2022'
   and cph.contracttype = 'CPL'
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   --and p.providerorganizationid is null 
   and cph.date >= '2025-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4    
)

 Select DISTINCT CTE.ProviderID 
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.OrderID is null then op.orderid else CTEC.OrderID end OrderID  
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.ProviderName is null then p.name else CTEC.ProviderName end ProviderName 
       ,CASE WHEN CTEC.Close_Date is null then CTE.Close_Date else CTEC.Close_Date end close_date
       ,CTEC.firstactivedate
       ,CTEC.lastactivedate
      FROM CTE     
     LEFT JOIN CTEC on CTEC.ProviderID = CTE.ProviderID 
     LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cte.providerid 
     LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.providerid = cte.providerid
  )

,CTEB AS(
Select CTE1.ProviderID 
      ,CTE1.ProviderName 
      ,CTE1.OrderID
      ,concat(CTE1.ProviderID, "-", CTE1.OrderID) ProviderOrderID 
      ,CASE WHEN cph.orderstatus is null then ost.name else cph.orderstatus end OrderStatus 
      ,case when cph.orderstatus is null then orst.name else cph.orderstatusreason end OrderStatusReason  
      ,Close_Date
      ,FirstActiveDate
      ,LastActiveDate 
      ,datediff(lastactivedate, firstactivedate) DaysActive
    --  ,CASE WHEN ost.name in ('Active', 'Paused') or orst.name in ('Monthly Cap Reached') then 'Active+' else 'Inactive' end Status
FROM CTE1 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cte1.orderid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost on ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype orst on orst.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cph.providerid = cte1.providerid and cph.orderid = cte1.orderid
 where cph.date = date(getdate()) 
)

 Select CTE1.ProviderID 
      ,CTE1.ProviderName 
      ,CTE1.OrderID
      ,concat(CTE1.ProviderID, "-", CTE1.OrderID) ProviderOrderID

LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cph.providerid = cte1.providerid and cph.orderid = cte1.orderid

SELECT hmcr.HMCRequestID

      ,HMCProspectID2
      ,affiliateID2
      ,disqualifier2
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as Channel
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

 FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
   LEFT JOIN CTE1 on CTE1.hmcprospectid2 = hmcr.hmcprospectid 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn

                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,

                    from prod.funnel_lead fl

                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false

select `ReferralID`,
    `LeadID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `HMCRequestID`,
    `YGL_Lead_ID`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `Activations`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    `ReturnApproved`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `Org`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `ReferralRevenue`
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
         ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`
limit 1000

select *
from (
With CTE2 AS( 
  WITH CTE1 AS( 
        WITH CTE AS( 
        Select cph.providerid 
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,min(cph.date) FirstActive
      ,max(cph.date) LastActive 
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
 JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
 WHERE (cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' or cph.orderstatus in ('Active', 'Paused'))
  and cph.contracttype = 'CPL' 
  and p.providerorganizationid is null 
 GROUP BY 1,2 
)

Select CTE.ProviderID 
      ,CTE.OrderID 
      ,CTE.FirstActive 
      ,CTE.LastActive 
      ,datediff(cte.lastactive, cte.firstactive) DaysActive
      ,ost.name OrderStatus 
      ,CASE WHEN o.prepaidtotal >= 290 and osrt.name = 'InsufficientBalance' then 'Monthly Cap Reached' else osrt.Name end OrderReason 
      ,CASE WHEN o.prepaidtotal >= 290 then "Prepaid" else "PAYG" end OrderType 
FROM CTE 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cte.orderid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost on ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt on osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
 WHERE FirstActive >= '2026'
)

,CTEA AS (
        Select CTE1.ProviderID 
      ,CTE1.OrderID 
      ,FirstActive 
      ,count(distinct ref.referralid) Referrals90
FROM CTE1
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.providerid = cte1.providerid  and ref.orderid = cte1.orderid 
  WHERE ref.hmcleadid is not null 
    and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
    and datediff(date(ref.referredon), firstactive) <= 90 and datediff(date(ref.referredon), firstactive) >= 0 
  GROUP BY 1,2,3 
)

,CTEB AS (
        Select CTE1.ProviderID 
      ,CTE1.OrderID 
      ,FirstActive 
      ,count(distinct ref.referralid) LifetimeReferrals 
      ,min(date(ref.activatedon)) FirstActivation
FROM CTE1
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.providerid = cte1.providerid  and ref.orderid = cte1.orderid 
  WHERE ref.hmcleadid is not null 
    and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
  GROUP BY 1,2,3 
)

,CTEC AS (  
 Select op.providerid 
      ,op.orderid 
      ,max(date(oc.createdon)) LastFreeLead
      ,sum(amount) FreeLeads
FROM cte1 
 left JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.orderid = cte1.orderid and op.providerid = cte1.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = op.orderid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.othercharge oc on oc.accountid = o.accountid 
   where otherchargetypeid = 1
    and lower(note) like '%free lead%' 
   Group by 1,2 

)

Select CTE1.*
      ,ctea.Referrals90 
      ,cteb.LifetimeReferrals
      ,ctec.FreeLeads
      ,lastfreelead
      ,FirstActivation 
      ,concat(cte1.providerid, "-", cte1.orderid) ProviderOrderID 
      ,CASE WHEN FirstActivation is not null then 'Activation' else 'No Activation' end HasActivation
      ,datediff(lastfreelead, cte1.firstactive)
      ,datediff(getdate(),cte1.firstactive) ProvOrderAge 
      ,CASE WHEN cte1.orderstatus in ("Active", "Paused") or cte1.orderreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' then 'Active'
         when cte1.orderstatus = 'Onboarding' then 'Onboarding' else 'Inactive' end Status 
FROM CTE1
 LEFT JOIN CTEA on CTEA.providerid = cte1.providerid and ctea.orderid = cte1.orderid
 LEFT JOIN CTEb on CTEb.providerid = cte1.providerid and cteb.orderid = cte1.orderid 
 LEFT JOIN CTEc on CTEc.providerid = cte1.providerid and ctec.orderid = cte1.orderid
)
,CTED AS( 
  Select CTE2.ProviderId 
         ,CTE2.OrderID 
         ,count(distinct ref.referralid) AfterFreeReferrals
    FROM CTE2 
     LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.providerid = cte2.providerid  and ref.orderid = cte2.orderid 
     where date(ref.referredon) >= lastfreelead 
      and ref.hmcleadid is not null 
      group by 1,2 
 
)

Select CTE2.* 
      ,afterfreereferrals
FROM CTE2 
left join cted on cted.providerid = cte2.providerid and cted.orderid = cte2.orderid
) as `_`
where 0 = 1

select * 
from 
(
    WITH CTE1 AS (
    WITH CTE AS (
      Select hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,hmcr.hmcrequestid 
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.requeststatusid = 2 then hmcr.hmcrequestid else null 
        END Rl
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.requeststatusid <> 6 then hmcr.hmcrequestid else null 
        END LSTF
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.url
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132) THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,136,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
          WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
          WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 THEN 'SEO'    
          WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
      END as AdjChannel
      ,r.Referralid
      ,r.providerid
      ,aff.affiliatename
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,hmcr.postalcode
      ,r.returnapproved
      ,msa.msa_name
      ,ci.Name City
      ,sp.name State
      ,dca.source oSource  
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate aff on aff.affiliateid = hmcr.affiliateid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
 LEFT JOIN (Select * 
      FROM  prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral
      WHERE hmcleadid is not null) r on r.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimhomecarerequest dchr on hmcr.hmcrequestid = dchr.requestid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimcustomeracquisition  dca on dca.CustomerAcquisitionKey = dchr.CustomerAcquisitionKey
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_dbo.zip_to_msa msa on trim(msa.zip_code) = trim(hmcr.Postalcode)
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_geo.city ci on ci.cityid =  pc.cityid
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_geo.stateprovince sp on sp.stateprovinceid = pc.stateprovinceid
 WHERE hmcr.createdate >= dateadd(day, -90, date(getdate())) and hmcr.createdate < date(getdate())
)

Select DISTINCT * 
      ,CASE WHEN affiliateID = 87 THEN 'Convertful'
            WHEN affiliateID = 92 THEN 'Typeform'
            WHEN affiliateID = 90 THEN 'Elderlife'
            WHEN affiliateID = 93 THEN 'LNSTF'
            WHEN affiliateID = 94 THEN 'SLA DQ'
            WHEN affiliateID = 95 THEN 'LNSTF - CN'
            WHEN affiliateID = 96 THEN 'LNSTF - WS'
            WHEN affiliateID = 97 THEN 'LNSTF Inbound'
            WHEN affiliateID = 99 THEN 'LNSTF - MaxZip'
            WHEN affiliateID = 106 THEN 'SLADQ - WT'
            WHEN affiliateID = 108 THEN 'No Tours'
            when affiliateID = 112 THEN 'APFM SEO'
            WHEN affiliateID = 113 THEN 'Elderlife API'
            WHEN affiliateID = 117 THEN 'Resistant to Referral'
            WHEN affiliateID = 119 THEN 'SLA DQ LP'
            WHEN affiliateID = 121 THEN 'HC Max Attempts'
            WHEN affiliateID = 133 THEN 'Brand Verticles'
            WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEM' AND url like '%msclkid%' THEN 'SEM - Bing'
            WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEM' AND url like '%gclid%' THEN 'SEM - Google'
            WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEM' and url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM - Unknown'
            WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEO' AND affiliateid = 6 THEN 'AgingCare.com'
            WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEO' AND affiliateid = 49 THEN 'Caregivers.com'
            WHEN AdjChannel = 'APFM' THEN 'APFM Screened Leads'
            WHEN AdjChannel = 'Email' THEN 'Email'
        ELSE affiliatename
        END as Source
     ,CASE WHEN AdjChannel <> 'SEM' THEN NULL 
	     WHEN charindex('adgroup',url) = 0 THEN NULL  
	  ELSE left(url,charindex('adgroup',url)-2) 
        END AS Campaign1
FROM CTE
Where (billingtypeid = 3 or billingtypeid is null)
)

Select Count(distinct hmcrequestid) Leads

    `HMCProspectID`,
    `disqualifier`,
    `Channel`,
    `userid`,
    `requeststatusid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `DJType`,
    `adjust_createdate`,
    `Time`,

    `ContactLastName`,
    `Prospect_Date`,

    `ScreeningDate`,
    `Outcome`,
    `OutcomeName`,
    `https://admin.agingcare.com/HMCLeadQueue/Home/Prospect/`,
    `ScreeningUserID`,
    `phonenumber`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
      WITH CTEB AS( 
      WITH CTEA AS ( 
      WITH CTE1 AS ( 
      WITH CTE AS (
      Select hmcr.HMCRequestID
      ,hmcr.HMCProspectID
      ,hmcpd.disqualifier  Disqualifier2    
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateid
 FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier 
 -- where hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141)
  
)
  
SELECT HMCRequestID
      ,HMCProspectID HMCProspectID2
      ,Disqualifier2 
      ,disqualifierreason
      ,affiliateID affiliateID2
 FROM CTE
      Where affiliateID in (117)
) 

SELECT hmcr.HMCRequestID
      ,hmcr.HMCProspectID
      ,hmcpd.disqualifier
      ,HMCProspectID2
      ,affiliateID2
      ,disqualifier2
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then 'Grace'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as Channel
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
 FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospect hmcp on hmcp.hmcprospectid = hmcr.hmcprospectid
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectdisqualifier hmcpd on hmcpd.hmcprospectdisqualifierid = hmcp.disqualifier
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
   LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
   LEFT JOIN CTE1 on CTE1.hmcprospectid2 = hmcr.hmcprospectid 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid IN (12,13,14,16,17,18,20,22,24)) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (select 
                    fl.beacon_inquiry_id,
                    to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) as inquiry_created_date_EST,
                    fl.inquiry_method,
                    fl.status,
                    fl.close_inquiry_reason,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_sub_channel,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_domain,
                    dfc.lt_form_submit_utm_campaign
                    from prod.funnel_lead fl
                    left join prod.dim_funnel_channel dfc on fl.funnel_lead_id = dfc.funnel_lead_id
                    where fl.is_default_exclusion is false
                    and lower(status) = 'closed'
                    and lower(close_inquiry_reason) like '%sent to leadqueue%'

                    and to_date(from_utc_timestamp(fl.inquiry_created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= '2025-03-16'
                    ) apfm ON apfm.beacon_inquiry_id = hmcr.affiliateinquiryid
  WHERE hmcr.createdate > '2024-01-01' AND (rn = 1 OR sr.hmcrequestid IS NULL)
   and hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141)
)

,HMCProspectID
,HMCProspectID2
,affiliateID
,affiliateID2

,Channel

,DJStep
,DJType
,disqualifier
,date_format(Adjust_CreateDate, 'HH') hours

Select DISTINCT
CTEB.HMCRequestID
,CTEB.HMCProspectID
,disqualifier
,Channel
,userid
,requeststatusid
,ISDJ
,DJStep
,DJType
,adjust_createdate
,Date_format(Adjust_CreateDate, 'HH:mm') Time
,CASE WHEN  requeststatusid = 4 then 'Max Attempts'
      WHEN CTEB.HMCProspectID = HMCProspectID2  and affiliateid2 in (117) then 'Resistant to Referral'
	  WHEN CTEB.HMCProspectID is null and requeststatusid = 3 then 'Misdirected Request'  
	  WHEN disqualifier is null and requeststatusid = 5 then 'Hard Stop'  
	  WHEN disqualifier is null and requeststatusid = 7 then 'APFM Matches Ignored'  
	  WHEN disqualifier is null and requeststatusid = 8 then 'Duplicated'  
      Else disqualifier 
        END disqualifierfixed
,CASE WHEN CTEB.HMCProspectID = HMCProspectID2  and affiliateid2 in (117) then null
 ELSE disqualifierreason
 END disqualifierreason_fixed
,disqualifierreason 
FROM CTEB
LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid 
                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY hmcrequestid ORDER BY createdate) rn
                    ,userid
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE createdate >= '2024-01-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = CTEB.hmcrequestid and rn =1 
--WHERE Channel <> 'APFM DQ' and Channel <> 'APFM' and --requeststatusid <> 1
) 

Select Distinct CTE2.*
      ,hmcr.firstname  ContactFirstName
      ,hmcr.lastname ContactLastName
      ,hmcp.createdate Prospect_Date
      ,hmcr.postalcode 
      ,sr.Createdate ScreeningDate
      ,sr.outcomeid Outcome
      ,o.outcomename OutcomeName
      ,'https://admin.agingcare.com/HMCLeadQueue/Home/Prospect/' 
      ,sr.userid ScreeningUserID 
      ,ppn.phonenumber

select `ReferralID`,

    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `activatedon`,
    `ActivatedOnDate`,
    `Activations`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    cast(`ReturnApproved` as BIGINT) as `C1`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `Providername`,
    `ReferralRevenue`
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,r.activatedon
      ,DATE(r.activatedon) AS ActivatedOnDate
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
    ,p.name Providername
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0

  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID

				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`

select `hmcrequestid`,
