    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `AttemptCount`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `Note`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `hmcscreenqueueid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `affiliateid`,
    `DJType`,
    `SourceP`,
    `C1`,
    `C2`,
    `C2` - `C1` as `C3`
from 
(
    select `hmcrequestid`,
        `Funnel`,
        `createdate`,
        `RequestStatusId`,
        `requeststatuscode`,
        `AdjChannel`,
        `ScreeningDate`,
        `Adjust_CreateDate`,
        `AttemptCount`,
        `userid`,
        `outcomeid`,
        `Note`,
        `affiliateID`,
        `hmcscreenqueueid`,
        `ISDJ`,
        `DJStep`,
        `djstepid`,
        `affiliateid`,
        `DJType`,
        `SourceP`,
        (cast({ fn year(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`createdate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`,
        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`
    from 
    (
        WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,a.affiliatename
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on a.affiliateID = hmcr.affiliateid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate

			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'

WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL)

      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'

select `ReferralID`,
    `LeadID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `HMCRequestID`,
    `YGL_Lead_ID`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `Activations`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    `ReturnApproved`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `Org`,
    `ReferralRevenue`
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
      ,case when p.providerorganizationid is null then 'Indpendent' else 'Franchise' end Org
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`
limit 1000

from 
(

  WITH CTE AS(

    zr.zip5

JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id

  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false

    zr.zip5

       ,CASE WHEN cte.zip5 is not null then 'South Texas' else 'Other' end PilotGroup

select `DateID`,
    `Date`,
    `ModDate`,
    `WeekStart`,
    `ModWeekStart`,
    `DayOfYear`,
    `DayOfMonth`,
    `DayOfWeek`,
    `WeekDayName`,
    `Month`,
    `MonthName`,
    `Year`,
    `ModYear`,
    `ModMonthYear`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `MonthYearID`,
    cast({ fn year(`ModDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002 + cast({ fn month(`ModDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C1`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS
(
SELECT DateID
      ,Date
	  ,CASE WHEN DayOfWeek = 2 THEN Date 
	  WHEN DayOfWeek > 2 THEN DATEADD(day, 2- DayOfWeek,Date)
	  ELSE DATEADD(day, -6,Date)
	  END as WeekStart
      ,DayOfYear
      ,DayOfMonth
      ,DayOfWeek
      ,WeekDayName
      ,Month
      ,MonthName
      ,Year
	  ,Year(Getdate()) as ModYear
	  ,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year(Getdate())) as ModMonthYear
,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year) AS MonthYear
      ,MonthYearID
  FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
  WHERE  DateID Between Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric) and Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric)
  )

  SELECT CTE.DateID
      ,CTE.Date
	  ,CASE WHEN CTE.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) THEN DATEADD(YEAR, 1, CTE.Date) 
	  ELSE CTE.Date
	  END as ModDate
	  ,CTE.WeekStart
	  ,COALESCE(cte2.WeekStart, CTE.WeekStart) as ModWeekStart
      ,CTE.DayOfYear
      ,CTE.DayOfMonth
      ,CTE.DayOfWeek
      ,CTE.WeekDayName
      ,CTE.Month
      ,CTE.MonthName
      ,CTE.Year
	  ,CTE.ModYear
	  ,CTE.ModMonthYear
,CTE.MonthYear
      ,CTE.MonthYearID
  FROM CTE 
  LEFT JOIN CTE cte2 on CTE.DayOfYear = cte2.DayOfYear AND cte2.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) AND CTE.Year = Year(Getdate())
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `hmcprospectid`,
    `postalcode`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `requeststatuscode`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `AttemptCount`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `Note`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `hmcscreenqueueid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `affiliateid`,
    `DJType`,
    `url`,
    `affiliatename`,
    `hours`,
    `minute`,
    `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
    `rn`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `Source`,
    `Campaign1`,
    `CampaignID`,
    `SourceP`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS (
      WITH CTE1 AS (
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,hmcr.affiliateid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 
     ,hmcr.url
     ,a.affiliatename 
    ,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.affiliate a on a.affiliateID = hmcr.affiliateid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2024-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

SElect *,
    date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',createdate)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour,
    HOUR(createdate) AS RequestHour,
    CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
    ELSE 0 END as DuringOperatingHours
    ,CASE WHEN affiliateID = 87 THEN 'Convertful'
WHEN affiliateID = 92 THEN 'Typeform'
WHEN affiliateID = 90 THEN 'Elderlife'
WHEN affiliateID = 93 THEN 'LNSTF'
WHEN affiliateID = 94 THEN 'SLA DQ'
WHEN affiliateID = 95 THEN 'LNSTF - CN'
WHEN affiliateID = 96 THEN 'LNSTF - WS'
WHEN affiliateID = 97 THEN 'LNSTF Inbound'
WHEN affiliateID = 99 THEN 'LNSTF - MaxZip'
WHEN affiliateID = 106 THEN 'SLADQ - WT'
WHEN affiliateID = 108 THEN 'No Tours'
when affiliateID = 112 THEN 'APFM SEO'
WHEN affiliateID = 113 THEN 'Elderlife API'
WHEN affiliateID = 117 THEN 'Resistant to Referral'
WHEN affiliateID = 119 THEN 'SLA DQ LP'
WHEN affiliateID = 121 THEN 'HC Max Attempts'
WHEN affiliateID = 133 THEN 'Brand Verticles'
WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEM' AND url like '%msclkid%' THEN 'SEM - Bing'
WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEM' AND url like '%gclid%' THEN 'SEM - Google'
WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEM' and url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM - Unknown'
WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEO' AND affiliateid = 6 THEN 'AgingCare.com'
WHEN AdjChannel = 'SEO' AND affiliateid = 49 THEN 'Caregivers.com'
WHEN AdjChannel = 'APFM' THEN 'APFM Screened Leads'
WHEN AdjChannel = 'Email' THEN 'Email'
ELSE affiliatename
END as Source
,CASE WHEN AdjChannel <> 'SEM' THEN NULL 
	        WHEN charindex('adgroup',url) = 0 THEN NULL  
		    ELSE left(url,charindex('adgroup',url)-2) END AS Campaign1
FROM CTE 
Where rn =1
order by hmcrequestid desc
)
Select CTE1.*  
      ,RIGHT(campaign1,len(campaign1) - charindex('campaignid=',campaign1) - 10) AS CampaignID
from CTE1 
)

Select CTE2.* ,CASE WHEN AdjChannel = "SEM" and CampaignID in (21152744542, 21149280686, 21142376391, 21142377831, 21142376379, 21149280908, 21149280227, 21152743894, 21149280179, 638388490, 638388484, 638388481, 638388480, 638388479, 638388478, 638388477, 638388476, 638388475, 638388474, 638388473, 638388472, 638388471, 638388470, 638388469, 638343060) then "Partner Campaigns"
                   WHEN AdjChannel = "SEM" and  CampaignID in (20883191214,638662372) then "PMax Campaigns"
                   WHEN AdjChannel = "SEM" and CampaignID is null then "Blank"
                   WHEN AdjChannel = "SEM" then "Core Campaigns"
                   Else Source
                   End SourceP

FROM CTE2

limit 1000

select `hmcrequestid`,

    `WhenCareNeeded`,
    `LessThan30Days`,
    `HT`,
    `ReferralID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `billingtypeid`,
    `providerid`,

    `ToActivation`,
    `returnapproved`,

            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 2 then "Within 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 3 then "Greater than 30 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 4 then "Unsure"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 5 then "Within 7 days"
            WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid = 6 then "No rush"
            else null
            END WhenCareNeeded
      ,CASE WHEN hmcp.hmcwhencareneededid in (1,2,5) then 1
            ELSE 0

     ,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
     ,ref.ReferralID 
     ,ref.ReferredOn
     ,ref.billingtypeid
     ,ref.providerid
     ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
     ,p.Name ProviderName
     ,po.name Org
     ,ref.activatedon
     ,CASE WHEN ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,1,ref.ReferredOn) then 1
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,1,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn)) then 2
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,2,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn)) then 3
           WHEN (ref.activatedon > timestampadd(Week,3,ReferredOn) and ref.activatedon <= timestampadd(Week,4,ReferredOn)) then 4

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `hmcprospectid`,
    `postalcode`,
    `Funnel`,
    `createdate`,
    `RequestStatusId`,
    `requeststatuscode`,
    `ScreeningDate`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `AttemptCount`,
    `userid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `Note`,
    `affiliateID`,
    `hmcscreenqueueid`,
    `ISDJ`,
    `DJStep`,
    `djstepid`,
    `DJType`,
    `hours`,
    `minute`,
    `((lateralAliasReference(hours) * 100) + lateralAliasReference(minute))`,
    `rn`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
      ,AttemptCount
      ,sr.userid
      ,sr.outcomeid
      ,pn.Note
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,sq.hmcscreenqueueid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'
     Else 'Not DJ'
     END ISDJ
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null and  hmcr.djstepid <> 100 then 'Dropped From DJ'
      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep
,hmcr.djstepid
,CASE WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 1 THEN 'SEM After Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 2 THEN 'Re-Engagement Text'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 4 THEN 'SEM In-Hours'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType 

    ,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'HH') hours
,date_format(hmcr.createdate, 'mm') minute
, (hours*100)+minute
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hmcr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY sr.hmcscreeningresultid desc) rn
  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead l on l.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT *
                      ,CASE WHEN userid = 1702946 
                              AND datediff(minute,LAG(createdate) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid),createdate) < 480
                              AND LAG(outcomeid) OVER (Partition BY sr.hmcrequestid ORDER BY hmcscreeningresultid) IN (12,13,14,16,17,22,24) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS APFMMisattribute
              FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult sr
              WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (5,15,19) and createdate >= '2023-11-01') sr on sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreenqueue sq on sq.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT HMCProspectID
				  ,CreateDate
				  ,Note
				  ,NoteID
				  ,Action
				  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCProspectID ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) rns
			  FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcprospectnotes
			  WHERE Action NOT LIKE 'Disqualified'
			  AND Action IN ('Answered Call', 'Responded to Email/Sms', 'Called In')
			  ) pn on pn.HMCProspectID = hmcr.HMCProspectID AND CAST(pn.CreateDate as Date) = CAST(sr.createdate as Date) AND pn.rns = 1
WHERE (sr.outcomeid NOT IN (5,15, 19) OR sr.outcomeid is NULL) 
AND hmcr.createdate >= '2025-01-01' AND sr.APFMMisattribute = 0

)

SElect *,
    date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',createdate)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour,
    HOUR(createdate) AS RequestHour,
    CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
    ELSE 0 END as DuringOperatingHours
FROM CTE 
Where rn =1
order by hmcrequestid desc
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `AccountID`,
    `AccountName`,
    `OrderID`,
    `OrderName`,
    `CurrentOrderStatus`,
    `CurrentOrderStatusReason`,
    cast(`OrderCreateDate` as DATE) as `C1`,
    `HCAM`,
    `HomecareChargeID`,
    `amount`,
    cast(`ChargeCreateDate` as DATE) as `C2`,
    `CPHOrderStatus`,
    `CPHOrderStatusReason`,
    `prepaidautorenew`,
    `prepaidtotal`,
    `RN`,
    `LagDate`,
    `LastOrderStatus`,
    `LastOrderStatusReason`,
    `DateSuspended`,
    cast(`CreateDate` as DATE) as `C3`,
    `CreateMonth`,
    `1DayLag`
from 
(
    WITH CTE1 AS ( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
      Select DISTINCT o.AccountID
      ,a.name AccountName 
      ,o.OrderID 
      ,o.name OrderName 
      ,ot.NAme OrderStatus 
      ,ost.Name OrderStatusReason
      ,o.createdon OrderCreateDate
      ,u.firstname HCAM 
      ,o.prepaidautorenew
      ,o.prepaidtotal
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.account a ON a.AccountID = o.AccountID
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype ost on  ost.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ot on ot.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.orderid = o.orderid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = op.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = p.HCAMUserID
  WHERE o.createdon >= '2024'
  and ot.name <> 'Onboarding'
  and o.billingtypeid = 3
)

Select DISTINCT CTE.AccountID 
      ,CTE.AccountName 
      ,CTE.OrderID 
      ,CTE.OrderName
      ,CTE.OrderStatus CurrentOrderStatus
      ,CTE.OrderStatusReason CurrentOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.OrderCreateDate
      ,CTE.HCAM 
      ,hcc.HomecareChargeID 
      ,CASE WHEN ref.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as amount
      ,hcc.createdon ChargeCreateDate
      ,cph.orderstatus CPHOrderStatus
      ,cph.orderstatusreason CPHOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.prepaidautorenew
      ,cte.prepaidtotal
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hcc.homecarechargeid ORDER BY cph.cartproviderhistoryid desc) as RN
      ,LagDate
      ,his.orderstatus LastOrderStatus
      ,his.orderstatusreason LastOrderStatusReason
      ,DateSuspended
FROM CTE 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.OrderID = CTE.OrderID 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.referralid = ref.referralid
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cast(cph.date as date) = cast(add_months(hcc.createdon, 1) as date) and cph.accountid = hcc.accountid and CTE.orderid = cph.orderid
 LEFT JOIN (Select distinct orderid, accountid,orderstatus, orderstatusreason, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY orderid ORDER BY Date desc) rn
           FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory) his on  his.accountid = cte.accountid and his.orderid = cte.orderid and his.rn = 1
 LEFT JOIN (Select distinct cph.*
                  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.Date desc) rn
                  ,LAG(cph.`date`,1 ) OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.date) LagDate
         FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
          LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid 
            WHERE cph.orderstatusreason = 'InsufficientBalance' and (o.prepaidtotal <580 or o.prepaidtotal is null)) temp on temp.accountid = cte.accountid and temp.orderid = cte.orderid and temp.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN (Select cph.*, date DateSuspended
                 ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.Date asc) rn
            FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
              LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid 
                WHERE cph.orderstatusreason = 'InsufficientBalance' and (o.prepaidtotal <580 or o.prepaidtotal is null) ) temp2 on temp2.accountid = cte.accountid and temp2.orderid = cte.orderid and temp2.rn = 1
   WHERE ref.hmcleadid is not null 
    and ref.billingtypeid = 3
    and (ref.returnapproved = false or ref.returnapproved is null)
)

SELECT *
,chargecreatedate CreateDate
,date_format(chargecreatedate,'MM-yyyy') CreateMonth
,CASE WHEN date_diff(LagDate, cast(add_months(ChargeCreateDate, 1) as date)) > 1 THEN 1 
      Else 0
      End 1DayLag
FROM CTE1
WHERE RN =1
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `ReferralID`,
    `LeadID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `HMCRequestID`,
    `YGL_Lead_ID`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    cast(`ReturnApproved` as BIGINT) as `C1`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `ReferralRevenue`,
    `ReferralCount`,
    `rn`
from 
(
    WITH CTE3 AS (
WITH CTE2 AS (
WITH CTE AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-12-01'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-12-01'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  AND r.createdon >= '2024-08-22'
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2024-08-22'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc)

  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HMCRequestID ORDER BY ReferralRevenue desc) AS ReferralCount
  FROM CTE
  WHERE IsHotTransfer = 0
  ORDER BY ReferralID desc)

  SELECT ref.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ref.HMCRequestID Order by AddOn desc) as rn
  FROM CTE2 ref
  RIGHT JOIN (SELECT HMCRequestID
              FROM CTE2
              GROUP BY HMCRequestID
              HAVING COUNT(ReferralID) > 4) req ON req.HMCRequestID = ref.HMCRequestID
  WHERE ReferralCount = 5 OR Addon = 1)

SELECT *
FROM CTE3 
WHERE rn = 1
) as `_`

select `AccountID`,
    `AccountName`,
    `OrderID`,
    `OrderName`,
    `CurrentOrderStatus`,
    `CurrentOrderStatusReason`,
    cast(`OrderCreateDate` as DATE) as `C1`,
    `HCAM`,
    `HomecareChargeID`,
    `amount`,
    cast(`ChargeCreateDate` as DATE) as `C2`,
    `CPHOrderStatus`,
    `CPHOrderStatusReason`,
    `prepaidautorenew`,
    `prepaidtotal`,
    `RN`,
    `LagDate`,
    `LastOrderStatus`,
    `LastOrderStatusReason`,
    `DateSuspended`,
    cast(`CreateDate` as DATE) as `C3`,
    `CreateMonth`,
    `1DayLag`
from 
(
    WITH CTE1 AS ( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
      Select DISTINCT o.AccountID
      ,a.name AccountName 
      ,o.OrderID 
      ,o.name OrderName 
      ,ot.NAme OrderStatus 
      ,ost.Name OrderStatusReason
      ,o.createdon OrderCreateDate
      ,u.firstname HCAM 
      ,o.prepaidautorenew
      ,o.prepaidtotal
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.account a ON a.AccountID = o.AccountID
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype ost on  ost.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ot on ot.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.orderid = o.orderid 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = op.providerid 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = p.HCAMUserID
  WHERE o.createdon >= '2024'
  and ot.name <> 'Onboarding'
  and o.billingtypeid = 3
)

Select DISTINCT CTE.AccountID 
      ,CTE.AccountName 
      ,CTE.OrderID 
      ,CTE.OrderName
      ,CTE.OrderStatus CurrentOrderStatus
      ,CTE.OrderStatusReason CurrentOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.OrderCreateDate
      ,CTE.HCAM 
      ,hcc.HomecareChargeID 
      ,hcc.amount 
      ,hcc.createdon ChargeCreateDate
      ,cph.orderstatus CPHOrderStatus
      ,cph.orderstatusreason CPHOrderStatusReason
      ,CTE.prepaidautorenew
      ,cte.prepaidtotal
      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hcc.homecarechargeid ORDER BY cph.cartproviderhistoryid desc) as RN
      ,LagDate
      ,his.orderstatus LastOrderStatus
      ,his.orderstatusreason LastOrderStatusReason
      ,DateSuspended
FROM CTE 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.OrderID = CTE.OrderID 
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.referralid = ref.referralid
 LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph on cast(cph.date as date) = cast(add_months(hcc.createdon, 1) as date) and cph.accountid = hcc.accountid and CTE.orderid = cph.orderid
 LEFT JOIN (Select distinct orderid, accountid,orderstatus, orderstatusreason, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY orderid ORDER BY Date desc) rn
           FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory) his on  his.accountid = cte.accountid and his.orderid = cte.orderid and his.rn = 1
 LEFT JOIN (Select distinct cph.*
                  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.Date desc) rn
                  ,LAG(cph.`date`,1 ) OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.date) LagDate
         FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
          LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid 
            WHERE cph.orderstatusreason = 'InsufficientBalance' and (o.prepaidtotal <580 or o.prepaidtotal is null)) temp on temp.accountid = cte.accountid and temp.orderid = cte.orderid and temp.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN (Select cph.*, date DateSuspended
                 ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cph.orderid ORDER BY cph.Date asc) rn
            FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph
              LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o on o.orderid = cph.orderid 
                WHERE cph.orderstatusreason = 'InsufficientBalance' and (o.prepaidtotal <580 or o.prepaidtotal is null) ) temp2 on temp2.accountid = cte.accountid and temp2.orderid = cte.orderid and temp2.rn = 1
   WHERE ref.hmcleadid is not null 
    and ref.billingtypeid = 3
    and (ref.returnapproved = false or ref.returnapproved is null)
)

        (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`

WITH CTE AS (

      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel

      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId

 ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid =140 then "Grace"
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'

      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
      WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'

     -- WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'

      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
      WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
  ELSE 'Affiliates'
  END as AdjChannel
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `ScreeningStartDateTime`,
    `FirstScreeningLagSeconds`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `requeststatusid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `ScreeningDateTime`,
    `postalcode`,
    `RequestDateTime`,
    `systimezone`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `ScreeningHour`,
    `TOD`,
    `TODFilter`,
    `CreateDate`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `SecondstoFirstScreen`,
    `Delayed60`,
    `Delayed180`
from 
(
    WITH CTE (Select DISTINCT hmcr.hmcrequestid 
        ,dateadd(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate) ScreeningStartDateTime
	  ,DATEDIFF(second, hmcr.createdate, DATEADD(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate)) FirstScreeningLagSeconds
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
          --  WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 107 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,113,133,107 ) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            --WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as AdjChannel
       ,hmcr.requeststatusid
       ,sr.outcomeid
       ,sr.createdate AS ScreeningDateTime
       ,hmcr.postalcode
       ,hmcr.createdate As RequestDateTime
       ,tz.systimezone
        ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,secondsinprospect
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (14,15) 
                        AND secondsinprospect is not null 
                        and attemptcount = 1
                        and createdate >= '2024-08-01' ) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
Where hmcr.createdate >= '2024-08-01' )

SELECT *
      , CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
ELSE 0 
END as DuringOperatingHours
,HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) AS RequestHour
,HOUR(ScreeningDateTime) AS ScreeningHour
,CASE WHEN HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (8,9,10,11) then 'Morning'
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (12,13,14,15,16) then 'Afternoon'
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (17,18,19,20) then 'Evening'
      else 'Other'
      end TOD
      ,CASE WHEN HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (8,9,10,11) then 1
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (12,13,14,15,16) then 2
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (17,18,19,20) then 3
      else 4
      end TODFilter
,date(adjust_createdate) CreateDate
,date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',RequestDateTime)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour
,DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) AS SecondstoFirstScreen
,case when DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) > 60 then hmcrequestid else null end as Delayed60
,case when DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) > 180 then hmcrequestid else null end as Delayed180
FROM CTE
WHERE AdjChannel NOT IN ('APFM','APFM DQ') AND FirstScreeningLagSeconds IS NOT NULL
) as `_`
limit 1000

select `hmcrequestid`,
    `ScreeningStartDateTime`,
    `FirstScreeningLagSeconds`,
    `AdjChannel`,
    `requeststatusid`,
    `outcomeid`,
    `ScreeningDateTime`,
    `postalcode`,
    `RequestDateTime`,
    `systimezone`,
    `Adjust_CreateDate`,
    `DuringOperatingHours`,
    `RequestHour`,
    `ScreeningHour`,
    `TOD`,
    `RequestHalfHour`,
    `SecondstoFirstScreen`,
    `Delayed60`,
    `Delayed180`
from 
(
    WITH CTE (Select DISTINCT hmcr.hmcrequestid 
        ,dateadd(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate) ScreeningStartDateTime
	  ,DATEDIFF(second, hmcr.createdate, DATEADD(second, -sr.SecondsInProspect, sr.createdate)) FirstScreeningLagSeconds
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
          --  WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 107 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,113,133,107 ) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            --WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as AdjChannel
       ,hmcr.requeststatusid
       ,sr.outcomeid
       ,sr.createdate AS ScreeningDateTime
       ,hmcr.postalcode
       ,hmcr.createdate As RequestDateTime
       ,tz.systimezone
        ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,secondsinprospect
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (14,15) 
                        AND secondsinprospect is not null 
                        and attemptcount = 1
                        and createdate >= '2024-08-01' ) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
Where hmcr.createdate >= '2024-08-01' )

SELECT *
      , CASE WHEN (HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) * 60 + MINUTE(Adjust_CreateDate)) BETWEEN (8*60+30) AND (22*60) THEN 1
ELSE 0 
END as DuringOperatingHours
,HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) AS RequestHour
,HOUR(ScreeningDateTime) AS ScreeningHour
,CASE WHEN HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (8,9,10,11) then 'Morning'
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (12,1,2,3,4) then 'Afternoon'
      when HOUR(Adjust_CreateDate) in (5,6,7,8) then 'Evening'
      else 'Other'
      end TOD
,date_format(dateadd(minute,floor(datediff(minute,'1900-01-01',RequestDateTime)/30)*30,'1900-01-01'),'HH:mm:ss') AS RequestHalfHour
,DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) AS SecondstoFirstScreen
,case when DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) > 60 then hmcrequestid else null end as Delayed60
,case when DATEDIFF(second,RequestDateTime,ScreeningStartDateTime) > 180 then hmcrequestid else null end as Delayed180
FROM CTE
WHERE AdjChannel NOT IN ('APFM','APFM DQ') AND FirstScreeningLagSeconds IS NOT NULL
) as `_`

Select Distinct date

      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap

 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25

            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent

select `Date`,
    `DMA`,
    cast({ fn round(cast(`MonthYear` as DOUBLE), 0) } as BIGINT) as `C1`,
    `Org`,
    `Adjust_MonthlyCap`,
    `Orders`
from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774
      and date >= '2025'
      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
      ,dma.DMA
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.providerservicecoverage psc on psc.providerid = p.providerid
LEFT JOIN main.reporting.dim_geography_zip_dma dma on dma.zip = psc.postalcode
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
   and psc.deleted = 0 
   and DMA <> 'NA'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)

select `providerid`,
    `orderid`,
    `ActivationTimeFrame`,
    `createdon`,
    `Referrals`,
    `ProviderName`,
    `ReturnApproved`,
    `ReturnVolume`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS (
      Select o.orderid 
     ,ost.name OrderStatus
     ,orst.name OrderStatusReason 
     ,op.providerid 
     ,o.createdon
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.order o 
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype orst on orst.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid 
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost on ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderprovider op on op.orderid = o.orderid
where date_diff(Day, o.createdon, getdate()) <= 60
)

,CTEA AS (
Select ref.providerid 
     ,ref.orderid 
     ,min(activatedon) FirstActivation
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
where activatedon is not null 
GRoup by 1,2
)
,CTEB AS (
      Select count(distinct ref.referralid) Referrals
            ,count(distinct CASE WHEN ref.returnapproved = true then ref.referralid else null end) ReturnApproved
            ,ref.orderid 
            ,ref.providerid 
      FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
      where ref.hmcleadid is not null
        and ref.billingtypeid = 3
      GROUP BY 3,4
)


Select distinct ref.providerid 
      ,CTE.orderid 
       ,CASE WHEN date_diff(Day, CTE.createdon, FirstActivation) <= 20 then "In First 20"
             WHEN date_diff(Day, CTE.createdon, FirstActivation) > 20 then "After First 20"
             WHEN FirstActivation is null then "No Activations"
             End ActivationTimeFrame
      ,CTE.createdon
      ,CTEB.Referrals
     ,p.name ProviderName
      ,CTEB.ReturnApproved
      , CASE WHEN CTEB.ReturnApproved/CTEB.Referrals  >=.10 then "High Returns"
       else "Normal Returns"
       end ReturnVolume 
FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref
JOIN CTE on CTE.providerid = ref.providerid and ref.orderid = CTE.orderid

    `DayOfMonth`,
    `DayOfWeek`,
    `WeekDayName`,
    `Month`,
    `MonthName`,
    `Year`,
    `ModYear`,
    `ModMonthYear`,
    `MonthYear`,
    `MonthYearID`,
    `datediff(date, getdate())`
from 
(
    WITH CTE AS
(
SELECT DateID
      ,Date
	  ,CASE WHEN DayOfWeek = 2 THEN Date 
	  WHEN DayOfWeek > 2 THEN DATEADD(day, 2- DayOfWeek,Date)
	  ELSE DATEADD(day, -6,Date)
	  END as WeekStart
      ,DayOfYear
      ,DayOfMonth
      ,DayOfWeek
      ,WeekDayName
      ,Month
      ,MonthName
      ,Year
	  ,Year(Getdate()) as ModYear
	  ,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year(Getdate())) as ModMonthYear
,CONCAT(MonthName, ' ', Year) AS MonthYear
      ,MonthYearID
  FROM prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimdate
  WHERE  DateID Between Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric) and Cast(Year(DATEADD(year,1,GETDATE()))*10000 as numeric)
  )

  SELECT CTE.DateID
      ,CTE.Date
	  ,CASE WHEN CTE.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) THEN DATEADD(YEAR, 1, CTE.Date) 
	  ELSE CTE.Date
	  END as ModDate
	  ,CTE.WeekStart
	  ,COALESCE(cte2.WeekStart, CTE.WeekStart) as ModWeekStart
      ,CTE.DayOfYear
      ,CTE.DayOfMonth
      ,CTE.DayOfWeek
      ,CTE.WeekDayName
      ,CTE.Month
      ,CTE.MonthName
      ,CTE.Year
	  ,CTE.ModYear
	  ,CTE.ModMonthYear
,CTE.MonthYear
      ,CTE.MonthYearID
      ,datediff(cte.date, getdate())
  FROM CTE 
  LEFT JOIN CTE cte2 on CTE.DayOfYear = cte2.DayOfYear AND cte2.Year = Year(DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE())) AND CTE.Year = Year(Getdate())
) as `_`
limit 1000

      ,disqualifier2
      ,hmcr.requeststatusid
      ,hmcp.disqualifierreason
      ,hmcr.affiliateID
      ,hmcr.createdate AS RequestDateTime
      ,hmcr.RequestStatusID
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as Channel
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid is not null then 'Started in DJ'

      WHEN  hmcr.djstepid = 100  THEN 'Completed in DJ'
      END DJStep

      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 3 THEN 'Re-Engagement Email'

      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 5 THEN 'SEO ADJ'
      WHEN hmcr.djtypeid = 6 THEN 'SEO IDJ'
     END DJType
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))

                    fl.inquiry_method,

Select distinct cph.date

 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on year(cte.date) = year(cph.date) and if(day(cte.date) >= 15, (day(cph.date) = 15 and month(cph.date) = month(cte.date)), date(cph.date) = cte.date)
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
 ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            WHEN cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent is null then 200 
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent >= .5*cph.monthlycap then cph.monthlycap
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and cph.monthlysent < .5*cph.monthlycap then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlysent is null and cph.monthlycap is null then 200 
       else cph.monthlycap

    `Activation`,
    `ActivationDate`,
    `htrreferral`,
    `PilotGroup`,
    `referredbysource`
from 
(
    with cte1 as( 
  WITH CTE AS( 
      SELECT

    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false

    zr.zip5

     Select date(hmcr.createdate) RequestCreatedate

            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            else "Care Advisor"
       END Referredby

       ,hmcr.leadsource

       ,case when ref.returnapproved is true then 'Returned'

       ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate

       ,CASE WHEN cte.zip5 is not null then 'South Texas' else 'Other' end PilotGroup

WHEN r.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121)THEN 'APFM DQ'

WHEN r.url LIKE '%email%' OR r.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'

select *
from (
WITH CTE AS( 
      SELECT
    r.region_id AS regionId,
    r.region_name AS regionName,
    zr.zip5
FROM main.prod_ygl_apfm.zip_region AS zr
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region AS r ON r.region_id = zr.region_id
JOIN main.prod_ygl_apfm.region_use ru ON ru.region_id = zr.region_id
AND ru.region_type_code = zr.region_type_code
WHERE ru.region_type_code = 'ADVISOR'
  AND r.region_name = 'South Texas'
  AND r.active = 1
  AND zr.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND r.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
  AND ru.`_fivetran_deleted` = false
ORDER BY
    r.region_id,
    zr.zip5
)
     Select date(hmcr.createdate) RequestCreatedate 
      ,hmcr.hmcrequestid
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.djstepid = 100 then 'DJ Completed' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'SLA' 
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid in (140,141) then "Grace"
            WHEN htr.referralid is not null then 'CA HT' 
            else 'CA Not HT'
       END Referredby
       ,ref.referralid 
       ,case when ref.returnapproved is true then 'Returned' 
             when ref.returnapproved is false then 'Attempted'
             else 'Not Attempted' 
             end ReturnStatus
       ,concat(ref.providerid, '-', ref.orderid) ProviderOrders
       ,date(ref.referredon) ReferralDate 
       ,case when day(hmcr.createdate) <= 7 then "First 7" 
            when date_diff(day, hmcr.createdate, last_day(hmcr.createdate)) < 6 then 'Last 7'
            else "Middle"
            end TimeFrame
      ,datediff(activatedon, requestcreatedate) DaystoActivation
       ,case when ref.activatedon is not null then 'Activated' else 'Not Activated' end Activation 
       ,date(ref.activatedon) ActivationDate 
       ,CASE WHEN cte.zip5 is not null then 'South Texas' else 'Other' end PilotGroup
FROM main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid 
JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral ref on ref.hmcleadid = hmcl.hmcleadid and ref.billingtypeid = 3 
 LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.hottransferresult htr on htr.referralid = ref.referralid and htr.hottransferresponseid = 1
 LEFT JOIN CTE on cte.zip5 = hmcr.postalcode
 WHERE hmcr.createdate >= '2026'
) as `_`
where 0 = 1

from 
(
    WITH CTE1 AS (
      WITH CTE AS(
    SELECT distinct cph.ProviderID
        ,cph.ProviderName
        ,case when p.providerorganizationid IS NULL THEN 'Independent' ELSE 'Franchise' END AS ProviderType
        ,cph.OrderID
        ,concat(cph.providerid, "-", cph.orderid) ProviderOrder
        ,o.createdon AS OrderCreateDate
        ,MIN(Date) AS FirstActiveDate
        ,Max(date) AS LastActiveDate

        ,u2.FirstName AS HCAM
        ,u.FirstName AS CSM

LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatustype ost ON ost.orderstatustypeid = o.orderstatustypeid
LEFT JOIN  prod_homecare_actransactional_ordermanagement.orderstatusreasontype osrt ON osrt.orderstatusreasontypeid = o.orderstatusreasontypeid
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = cph.ProviderID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u ON u.UserID = AccountSpecialistUserID
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_auth.users u2 ON u2.UserID = HCAMUserID
WHERE Date >= '2022-01-01' and (cph.orderstatus = 'Active' OR cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached' OR cph.orderstatus = 'Paused') AND ContractType = 'CPL'

from

      with CTEA AS  ( 
     Select DISTINCT s.accountid 
      ,s.balance

      ,lag(s.balance) OVER (PARTITION BY s.accountid ORDER BY s.duedate ) PriorMonth

where a.paymentmethodtypeid = 3

)

       ,DueDate
       ,PaymentMonth

    (cast({ fn year(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+004 + cast({ fn month(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) * 1.000000000000000E+002) + cast({ fn dayofmonth(`ScreeningDate`) } as DOUBLE) as `C2`

WITH CTE AS (

      ,hmcr.hmcprospectid
      ,postalcode
    ,CASE WHEN hmcr.customflow = 1 THEN 'NFE' ELSE 'OFE' END as Funnel
      ,hmcr.createdate
      ,HMCR.RequestStatusId
      ,hmcr.requeststatuscode
      ,CASE WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (98,100,101,102,103,104,105,109,110,123,124,125,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,134) THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 87 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 92 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (90,107,113,133) THEN 'Affiliates'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121,136)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
       --     WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 AND apfm.lt_form_submit_channel = 'SEM' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid = 138 then "AgingCare Manual"
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
        ELSE 'Affiliates'
        END AdjChannel 
      ,sr.createdate as ScreeningDate
      ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate

When AgentName = 'Kate Cruz' THEN 'kate.cruz'

            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID IN (93,94,95,96,97,99,106,108,117,119,121)THEN 'APFM DQ'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%msclkid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%gclid%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%campaignid%' THEN 'SEM'
            WHEN hmcr.url LIKE '%email%' OR hmcr.affiliateID = 111 then 'Email'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid IN (6,49) OR hmcr.url LIKE '%/local%' OR hmcr.url LIKE '%local/%' THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateID = 112 THEN 'SEO'
            WHEN hmcr.affiliateid = 72 THEN 'APFM'
            WHEN hmcr.url IS NULL AND hmcr.affiliateid IN (36,47) THEN 'Unknown'
            ELSE 'Affiliates'
            END as AdjChannel
       ,hmcr.requeststatusid
       ,sr.outcomeid
       ,sr.createdate AS ScreeningDateTime
       ,hmcr.postalcode
       ,hmcr.createdate As RequestDateTime
       ,tz.systimezone
        ,CASE WHEN tz.timezoneid = 4 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','Pacific/Honolulu',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 6 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Alaska',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 10 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','US/Pacific',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 13 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Boise',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 15 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Chicago',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 26 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Glace_Bay',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              WHEN tz.timezoneid = 20 then convert_timezone('America/Detroit','America/Detroit',CAST(hmcr.createdate as TIMESTAMP))
              ELSE hmcr.createdate
              END Adjust_CreateDate
FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimpostalcode pc on pc.code = trim(hmcr.postalcode)
LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.dimtimezone tz on tz.timezoneid = pc.timezoneid
LEFT JOIN (SELECT hmcrequestid,hmcprospectid,outcomeid,userid,createdate,secondsinprospect
				FROM prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcscreeningresult
				WHERE outcomeid NOT IN (14,15) 
                        AND secondsinprospect is not null 
                        and attemptcount = 1
                        and createdate >= '2024-08-01' ) sr ON sr.hmcrequestid = hmcr.hmcrequestid
Where hmcr.createdate >= '2024-08-01' )

select `ReferralID`,
    `LeadID`,
    `HMCProspectID`,
    `HMCRequestID`,
    `YGL_Lead_ID`,
    `ProviderID`,
    `BillingTypeID`,
    `ReferralStatusTypeID`,
    `ReferredOn`,
    `activatedon`,
    `ActivatedOnDate`,
    `Activations`,
    `HT`,
    `TopOffQueue`,
    `AddOnType`,
    `AddOn`,
    `CreatedOn`,
    `ReturnApproved`,
    `HMCLeadID`,
    `OrderID`,
    `digitaljourney`,
    `PaceReferral`,
    `IsHotTransfer`,
    `Amount`,
    `Providername`,
    `ReferralRevenue`,
    `ReturnApproved` as `C1`
from 
(
    SELECT DISTINCT r.ReferralID
      ,r.LeadID
	  ,l.HMCProspectID
	  ,hmcr.HMCRequestID
	  ,l.ExternalIdentifier as YGL_Lead_ID
      ,r.ProviderID
      ,r.BillingTypeID
      ,ReferralStatusTypeID
      ,ReferredOn
      ,r.activatedon
      ,DATE(r.activatedon) AS ActivatedOnDate
      ,case when r.activatedon is not null then 1 else 0 end Activations
,CASE WHEN hmcl.HotTransferred IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as HT
,CASE WHEN r.IsTopOff = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TopOffQueue
,CASE WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 1 THEN 'AddOn' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 2 THEN 'NeighborZip' 
      WHEN r.AddOnTypeID = 3 THEN 'ZipAddOn' ELSE Null END AS AddOnType
,CASE WHEN r.addontypeid IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AddOn
      ,r.CreatedOn
      ,cast(ReturnApproved as int)
      ,r.HMCLeadID
      ,OrderID
      ,r.digitaljourney
	  ,CASE WHEN p.IsPace = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PaceReferral
          ,CAST(hcc.IsHotTransfer AS int)
	  ,hcc.Amount
    ,p.name Providername
	  	,CASE WHEN r.BillingTypeID = 1 then 18
        WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-06' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN 0       
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024-11-22 21:33:00'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN hcc.Amount
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND log.DeliveryStatusTypeID IN (2,3) AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024' AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0  THEN -42         
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -42
			  WHEN  hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.CreatedOn >= '2024'  AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 42
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount <0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN -34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.Amount > 0 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 0 THEN 34
			  WHEN hcc.AccountID = 2426 AND hcc.IsHotTransfer = 1 THEN 0
			ELSE hcc.Amount END as ReferralRevenue
  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.referral r
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.lead l on r.LeadID = l.LeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p ON p.ProviderID = r.ProviderID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_actransactional_billing.homecarecharge hcc on hcc.ReferralID = r.ReferralID AND hcc.IsCredit = 0
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmclead hmcl on hmcl.HMCLeadID = r.HMCLeadID
  LEFT JOIN prod_homecare_insite_directory.hmcrequest hmcr on hmcl.HMCRequestID = hmcr.HMCRequestID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT  DeliveryLogID
					  ,DeliveryName
					  ,ReferralID
					  ,DeliveryStatusTypeID
				  FROM prod_homecare_actransactional_homecare.deliverylog
				  WHERE DeliveryName = 'HomeInsteadProvider') log ON hcc.ReferralID = log.ReferralID
  WHERE 1=1
  --AND BillingTypeID = 3
  AND r.HMCLeadID IS NOT NULL
  AND hmcr.createdate > '2021'
  ORDER BY ReferredOn desc
) as `_`

from 
(
    WITH CTE2 AS( 
WITH CTE1 AS( 
      WITH CTE AS ( 
Select Distinct date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear
      ,monthlysent 
      ,monthlycap
      FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
      WHERE cph.orderid = 2774

      and (date = last_day(date) or date= date(getdate()))
)

Select distinct cph.date
      ,date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy') MonthYear   
      ,CASE when CTE.date = last_day(CTE.date) then cte.monthlysent else CTE.monthlycap end HICap
 FROM cte
 left join main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph  on cte.monthyear = date_format( cph.date, 'MMyyyy')
 and day(cph.date) = 15
 and cph.date >='2025'
)

      Select Distinct cph.date
      ,cph.orderid 
      ,cph.monthlycap
      ,case WHEN cph.orderid = 3265 then 2500
             WHEN cph.orderid = 2774 then CTE1.HICap
            when cph.monthlycap is null and cph.monthlysent is not null then (2*cph.monthlysent)
            WHEN cph.monthlycap is null then 25
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and  cph.monthlycap < (2*cph.monthlysent) then 2*cph.monthlysent
            when cph.monthlycap >= 200 and (cph.monthlycap >= (2*cph.monthlysent) or cph.monthlysent is null) then 200
       else cph.monthlycap 
      end  Cap
    ,CASE WHEN p.providerorganizationid is null then "Independent"
        else "Franchise"
        END Org
      ,cph.monthlysent 
    --  ,cph.ordername
FROM main.prod_homecare_acreporting_reporting.cartproviderhistory cph 
LEFT JOIN main.prod_homecare_actransactional_organization.provider p on p.providerid = cph.providerid 
LEFT JOIN CTE1 on cte1.date = cph.date
  WHERE (day(cph.date) = 15 or if(day(getdate()) < 15, cph.date = date(getdate()), day(cph.date) = 15))
   and (cph.orderstatus in ('Active','Paused') or cph.orderstatusreason = 'Monthly Cap Reached')
   and cph.date >= '2024'
   and contracttype = 'CPL'
Order by Date desc,cap desc

)
